jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.description:
Hledáme samostatného a kreativního člověka na pozici Marketing specialista pro e-commerce | obsah e-shopu & email marketing do rychle rostoucí české společnosti ALORI, která každý den odbavuje tisíce objednávek a patří mezi dynamicky rostoucí značky v oblasti produktů pro domácnost.
Náplní práce je především správa obsahu na e-shopu, aktualizace produktových textů, kategorií, bannerů a dalších prvků webu tak, aby zákazníci měli vždy k dispozici atraktivní, aktuální a kvalitně zpracovaný obsah podporující prodeje. Součástí práce je také příprava a realizace e-mail marketingových kampaní, newsletterů a automatizovaných scénářů pro komunikaci se stávajícími zákazníky.
Pozice zahrnuje také spolupráci na tvorbě marketingového obsahu pro nové produkty, reklamní kampaně, akční nabídky, sociální sítě a další marketingové aktivity společnosti. Hledáme člověka, který má cit pro text, detail, orientuje se v online prostředí a chápe, že kvalitní obsah a správná komunikace mají přímý vliv na výsledky e-shopu.
Výhodou jsou zkušenosti s e-commerce, správou obsahu, e-mail marketingovými nástroji, AI technologiemi a automatizacemi. Nehledáme pouze administrativního pracovníka, ale člověka, který chce aktivně přicházet s nápady, zlepšovat výkon marketingových aktivit a být součástí moderní firmy, která rychle roste a využívá nejnovější technologie.

Zaměstnanecké výhody:
Nabízíme stabilní práci v moderní české firmě, která dynamicky roste a neustále posouvá hranice v e-commerce. U nás nebudeš jen malou součástí velkého korporátu - tvoje práce bude mít reálný dopad a výsledky své práce uvidíš velmi rychle. Čeká tě přátelský kolektiv, moderní pracovní prostředí v Olomouci, férové finanční ohodnocení a možnost profesního i kariérního růstu společně s firmou.
Získáš také možnost pracovat s moderními technologiemi a AI nástroji, podílet se na zlepšování procesů a přicházet s vlastními nápady. Samozřejmostí jsou zaměstnanecké slevy na produkty ALORI, firemní akce a prostředí firmy, kde se věci řeší rychle, bez zbytečné byrokracie a kde si vážíme lidí, kteří chtějí růst společně s námi.

Máš vztah k práci se dřevem a chceš se podílet na výrobě domů, které dávají smysl? Do týmu RD Rýmařov hledáme spolehlivého dělníka.

Jak bude vypadat Tvá práce?
• Budeš vyrábět stěny, příčky, stropy a další díly pro montáž dřevostaveb.
• Pracovat na automatizovaných výrobních linkách i s ručním nářadím.
• Obrábět a upravovat dřevěné materiály pomocí ručních, elektrických i pneumatických strojů.
• Připravovat stavební otvory pro okna, dveře a instalační technologie.
• Osazovat izolační materiály, parozábrany a difuzní fólie.
• Kompletovat jednotlivé dílce do větších konstrukčních celků.
• Provádět prostupy, drážky a další úpravy konstrukcí podle výrobních požadavků.
• Podílet se na prefabrikaci nosných rámových konstrukcí dřevostaveb.
• Zajišťovat povrchové úpravy a finální dokončení jednotlivých výrobků.

Jak si Tě představujeme?
• Jsi pracovitý, spolehlivý, samostatný a manuálně zručný.
• Nevadí Ti fyzická práce a máš dobrý zdravotní stav.
• Dokážeš pracovat v týmu i samostatně.
• Nevadí Ti práce ve vícesměnném provozu včetně práce v noci.

Co Ti můžeme nabídnout?
• nástupní mzda 28.000 Kč, po úplném zapracování 35.000 Kč
• Máme zkrácenou pracovní dobu – 37,5 hodiny týdně.
• Pracovní poměr na 2 roky s možností prodloužení.
• Závodní stravování za výhodnou cenu.
• K tomu týden dovolené navíc (celkem 25 dní ročně).
• Přispějeme ti na dovolenou i na údržbu OOPP.
• Přispíváme na rekreaci dětí, penzijní připojištění nebo doplňkové penzijní spoření.
• Slavíš narozeniny nebo jiná životní výročí? Máme pro tebe odměnu!
• Cestovní pojištění na soukromé zahraniční výlety.
• Využít můžeš i výhodné telefonní tarify.
• Nabízíme očkování proti chřipce.
• A protože práce má být i zábava, můžeš se těšit na firemní akce a vzdělávání.

Co bude součástí práce
Převážně se bude pracovat s cizinci - dětmi, případně dospělými nebo celými rodinami - při jejich integraci do českého prostředí. Jedná se zejména o:

"         pomoc s orientací v českém systému a prostředí
Práce probíhá v Kraji Vysočina, zejména v krajském městě, případně v okresních městech.
Není vyžadována
"         znalost cizího jazyka, řidičský průkaz

Nabízíme
"         mzda podle tabulkových hodnot pro sociální služby stanovených MPSV plus osobní ohodnocení
"         přídavná dovolená, inspirující práce v čistém prostředí a v přátelském kolektivu

pracovní smlouvy uzavíráme zprvu na jeden rok s předpokladem opakování a přechodu na dobu neurčitou.
Legislativa a bezpečnostní požadavky
U pracovních pozic v rámci registrované sociální služby je nutné před nástupem doložit bezúhonnost výpisem z rejstříku trestů (ověření bezúhonnosti). Zaměstnavatel zajistí další vzdělávání pracovníků v souladu s § 111 zákona o sociálních službách.

Výběrové řízení probíhá průběžně až do obsazení pracovního místa.
Zájemci zašlou životopis a motivační dopis e mailem na adresu fpoint@fpoint.cz a do předmětu zprávy uvedou "Výběrové řízení".
Vybraní uchazeči budou pozváni k osobnímu pohovoru. V dalším kole může být součástí výběru také praktická zkouška. Při rozhodování zohledňujeme i dobré reference.

Voor deze dubbele rol zoeken we kandidaten met aantoonbare ervaring in telefonisch klantcontact of een servicegerichte omgeving. Ervaring in de banken- of verzekeringssector is een pre, maar geen vereiste. Belangrijker is dat je snel kunt schakelen tussen verschillende geavanceerde computersystemen, communicatief sterk bent en plezier hebt in het oplossen van uiteenlopende klantvragen. Je wordt uitgebreid ingewerkt.

Werk voor twee van de grootste financiele merken van Nederland!

Ben jij op zoek naar een afwisselende en inhoudelijke baan in de financiele sector? En wil jij je cv een enorme boost geven door ervaring op te doen bij zowel ING als Nationale Nederlanden? Als Klantcontact Medewerker ben jij de verbindende factor voor de klanten van deze topmerken. Een functie vol dynamiek, groei en afwisseling!

Jouw werkplek: ING en Nationale Nederlanden (via Tempo Team)
Je komt te werken in een professionele, moderne en innovatieve werkomgeving. Zowel ING als Nationale Nederlanden staan bekend om hun mensgerichte cultuur en uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden. Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en enthousiast team dat elkaar helpt en versterkt.

De functie en jouw uitdagingen
In deze rol help je klanten met uiteenlopende vragen over financiele producten en diensten van ING en Nationale Nederlanden. Omdat je voor twee grote merken werkt, is geen dag hetzelfde en blijf je jezelf continu uitdagen.

Jouw uitdagingen in deze rol:

Schakelen tussen verschillende systemen en merken: Je duikt snel in de achterliggende klantsystemen van zowel ING als NN om de situatie van de klant helder te krijgen.

Inhoudelijke en klantgerichte service verlenen: Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt, luistert actief naar de klantvraag en geeft een helder en deskundig antwoord.

Continu jezelf blijven ontwikkelen: Je volgt uitgebreide, betaalde trainingen en leert de fijne kneepjes van het financiele vak, wat jou een ijzersterke basis geeft voor de toekomst.

Wil jij aan de slag in een veelzijdige functie bij twee absolute marktleiders? Reageer dan direct en start jouw carriere via Tempo Team!

jobs.title: Arcade and VR Operator
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about gaming, customer service, and cutting-edge VR technology? We are looking for an energetic and reliable Arcade & VR Gaming Centre Operator to join our team! In this role, you will be the face of our gaming centre welcoming guests, ensuring a seamless gaming experience, and keeping our facility running smoothly.

DeGameZone is a modern entertainment and recreation venue focused on delivering high-energy arcade and virtual reality (VR) experiences. Combining classic arcade gaming with state-of-the-art VR technology, DeGameZone offers a social hub where gamers, families, and groups can connect, compete, and explore immersive virtual worlds.  
Why Join DeGameZone?
Be at the Center of Entertainment: You get to work in a vibrant, fast-paced environment where creating fun and memorable experiences for guests is the daily goal.
Hands-on Technology: You will gain experience operating and troubleshooting modern VR systems alongside arcade machinery.  
Dynamic Work Atmosphere: Every shift brings a variety of tasks from welcoming guests and running point of sale operations (kassa) to hosting VR sessions and guiding players.
Competitive Compensation & Perks: Enjoy a solid salary (Euro 2,400 to Euro 4,000/month pro-rata), holiday allowance (vakantiegeld), accrued paid leave.

jobs.title: Recruiter

Sluiten
VPG Techniek Recruiter bij VPG Techniek Intro
Word jij enthousiast van het vinden van technisch talent? VPG Techniek zoekt een Interne Recruiter in Woerden die recruitment naar een hoger niveau tilt. Jij bouwt aan ons werkgeversmerk, verbindt technische professionals aan onze organisatie en krijgt de vrijheid om recruitment binnen zes technische bedrijven vorm te geven. Dit is je uitdaging

Train smart: follow your capacity, not just the physical activity guidelines Train slim
13 July
Ana Rodrigues
We all know that exercise is healthy. But how much exercise is actually enough? And do you always have to give it your all during every workout? The Dutch Physical Activity Guidelines provide a good starting point for this. For adults, the advice is to to exercise moderately intensely for at least 150 minutes per week, and to perform muscle- and bone-strengthening exercises at least twice a week. to do and limit prolonged sitting as much as possible. It is important to know that this no targets , but the minimum amount of exercise which is necessary to stay healthy.
However, in practice, we see that many people unconsciously deal with this in two ways. They either do too little because work, family, or other obligations always take precedence, or they deliberately try to perform at their maximum during every training session, even on days when their body is actually not ready for it. Listen to your body
No two days are the same. One day you feel energetic and strong, while on another you may have slept less well, be under a lot of stress, or simply feel more tired. That is precisely why it is important not only to follow a training schedule, but also to listen to your load capacity to check. A simple way to do this is to ask yourself one question before every training:
"How strong do I feel today? "
Give yourself a score of 0 to 10. - 8 to 10: Do you feel fit and energetic? Then feel free to challenge yourself a little extra. - 5 to 7: Great energy? Follow your normal training schedule. - 0 to 4: Low energy? Scale back the training slightl...

jobs.description:
EMA Centralised Procedure - Analysis of Marketing Authorisation Applications
Author
Cornelis Jansma
Published on
April 29, 2026
The European Medicines Agency (EMA) focus group on submission predictability monitoring report (H2-25 MAAs pipeline monitoring exercise) makes one thing clear: predictability in Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAA) is improving, but industry still has significant room to mature.
Key findings include: - 57% of MAAs were submitted on time, up from 48% in 2023. - Short-notice delays remain a major issue: over 60% of applicants provided less than 60 days' advance warning before shifting their submission date. - Justifications for delays are often missing or uninformative; only 73% of applicants who changed their plans provided a justification, and many cited internal resource constraints or planning issues. - Generics and biosimilars frequently bypass timely Letters of Intent, creating additional unpredictability. - While communication between applicants and regulators has improved, the overall planning reliability remains insufficient to support efficient workload allocation across the EU regulatory network.
The report concludes that although progress is visible, predictability challenges continue to strain regulatory resources, and further improvements in applicant planning and transparency are essential. EMA will continue monitoring but will shift focus toward new approaches aligned with the upcoming New Pharmaceutical Legislation.
With the regulatory network under increasing workload pressure, companies that invest in predictable, well-governed submission processes will be better positioned for smooth assessments and timely approvals.

The Director of Operational Planning & Value Realisation is responsible for the commercial stewardship of Service Operations.

We're looking for a firestarter to join our marketing team. You'll lead our events programme end to end, own how the Cytix brand shows up across every channel (digital, events, customers and partners), and build a community of people who champion Cytix because they've experienced it first-hand.

We've just rebuilt the Cytix brand from the ground up, with new positioning, a new voice, and a new visual identity. Your job is to take it out into the world and make sure that wherever someone meets Cytix, whether at an expo stand, in a partner deck, or on our social channels, it looks and sounds unmistakably like us. This is a doing role at a small company: real ownership from week one, real targets to hit, and direct access to the leadership team.

What you'll do

  • Research, book and organise all GTM events for the commercial team, from large expos to smaller sponsorship opportunities and Cytix-hosted events.

  • Own the ambitious lead generation targets allocated to our events programme. You'll care as much about what an event produces as how it runs.

  • Own event delivery end to end: budgets, logistics, stand design, materials, speaker support, and the follow-up that turns conversations into pipeline.

  • Be the point of reference for any brand question across the company, keeping everything from a sales deck to an event stand true to our voice and visual identity, and helping colleagues get it right rather than just correcting them after.

  • Through your events programme, create and nurture a community of Cytix champions: the customers, partners and practitioners who talk about us when we're not in the room.

  • Measure what's working, event ROI, leads generated, community growth, brand consistency, and feed it back into what we do next.

What you'll bring

  • A few years' experience in B2B marketing with real event delivery under your belt: you've booked venues, negotiated with sponsors, built stands, and know what a well-run event feels like from the inside.

  • A commercial head: you're comfortable being measured on what your events generate, not just how smoothly they ran.

  • A creative eye - you know how to make Cytix stand out in a saturated events hall with iterations of the same booth design and messaging

  • Strong organisational instincts.

  • Good writing and a sharp eye for brand: you can hold a voice that isn't your own and spot when something drifts off-identity.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: briefs won't always be complete, and we'd rather you make a sensible start than wait for one.

  • Willingness to travel to events and be visibly, energetically present at them. Security or tech industry experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

What you'll get

  • Share options. If Cytix wins, you should too.

  • Enhanced maternity pay.

  • Octopus car scheme. Drive electric through salary sacrifice.

  • Dog-friendly office.

  • Inclusivity as standard. A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.



You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Description:

ABOUT US:

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Lead the valuation process for portfolio assets and oversee the preparation and review of valuations for each NAV calculation, ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance with applicable valuation standards and internal policies;
Drive the valuation assessment of new investment opportunities, providing independent challenge and expert judgment on pricing assumptions, methodologies and transaction structures;
Perform and oversee detailed financial, operational and market analysis of portfolio assets and the sectors in which they operate, identifying key value drivers, risks and opportunities;
Prepare and review comprehensive valuation reports, presenting valuation conclusions, methodologies, key assumptions and sensitivities to senior management and governance bodies;
Present valuation analyses and recommendations to the Valuation Committee and actively contribute to valuation-related discussions and decision-making processes;

Support and mentor junior team members, fostering technical excellence and knowledge sharing within the valuation function.


YOUR PROFILE:

You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years of direct valuation experience gained within asset management, advisory, valuation consulting, audit, private markets, or a similar environment;

jobs.title: Director Finance, Operations & Supply Chain (m/f/d)
jobs.employer: HUSKY INJECTION MOLDING SYSTEMS S.A R.L.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.
    Analyze the financial impact of inventory-related decisions and provide recommendations for improvement.

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.
    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
    Proven experience (10+ years) in a senior finance role within a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.
    Systems / ERP capability
        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English
    Additional language skills considered an asset

The Supplier Quality Analyst is the primary point of contact both internally and externally for all activities related to Quality at their suppliers.  They will answer all quality related inquiries and will enhance the compliance to Husky's qualification standards (i.e., re-qualify existing suppliers).

The Supplier Quality Analyst will monitor suppliers' performance, organize, and execute Supplier Audits, follow-up on Supplier Improvement Plans and execute Part Qualifications.

In collaboration with the Clinic team, the Supplier Quality Analyst will support root cause analysis & permanent corrective actions.


Responsibilities:

Define & execute supplier surveillance audit plans to maintain or re-qualify existing suppliers according to latest Husky standards.
Define supplier improvement plans, follow-up on action implementation and effectiveness at suppliers.
Monitor supplier performance & proactively act or react accordingly.
Manage Part Qualifications for their suppliers.
Participate in Andon & Clinic activities related to their suppliers.
Support and verify execution of containment actions at suppliers.
Support execution of containment actions at Supplier
Contribute to Root Cause Analysis and Permanent Corrective Action determination and follow-up on implementation at supplier.
Partner with stakeholders for execution of Andon/Clinic tasks outside of direct area of responsibilities
Support new supplier qualification.
Participate in the continuous improvement of methods & standard of Supply Chain Quality Management System


Qualifications and Skills:

Engineering, Supplier Audit Certification is preferred.
5 years' Quality/Project Management/Supply Chain experience: technical, supply chain or operations role with process development
Strong Quality background required. Good understanding of Quality needs (e.g., what internal/external suppliers provide, what customers expect, and what performance measurement metrics are)
Understanding of tools and processes related to Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP); ability to facilitate sessions with partners.
Good technical understanding of Supplier's manufacturing, assembly, logistic processes - be able to evaluate sound of a process even without having a deep technical knowledge. Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and define corrective action.
Ability to apply an analytical, process-oriented approach to solving problems across a variety of situations and activities.
Ownership, accountability, and confidence to take decisions. Be able to ability to work in ambiguity.
Strong project and change management skills.
Hands-on data collection and analysis skills, with a high attention to detail
Ability to work in a fast-changing environment with a willingness to change, flexibility and learning agility.
Excellent problem-solving skills and tenacity to drive the resolution to conclusion.
Understanding of lean principles to enhance quality process design and operations.
Understands the need and benefit of Quality Assurance
Understanding of ISO Quality Management System requirements & business/industry standards
Excellent written and spoken command of English and German, additional languages are a plus.
Audit capabilities, Audit skill & knowledge, good relationship skills
Good understanding of Husky's product design, standards, and manufacturing technologies for a wide range of product types; process engineering can be generic/agnostic of product.
Travel required at Supplier (25%)


Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.

jobs.title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
SENIOR FUND ACCOUNTING OFFICER

Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.
• Clear and confident communicator with internal teams and clients.
• Proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our New York office.We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $65.38 – $76.92/hr.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Uz prijavu na javni natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:
  1. Zamolbu
  2. Životopis
  3. Dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica ili domovnica)-preslika
  4. Dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (diploma) - preslika
  5. Elektronički zapis s podacima o radnom stažu i radnom odnosu iz HZMO-a
  6. Uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 6 mjeseci) – izvornik ili preslika
  7. Uvjerenje o položenome stručnom ispitu – preslika (nije uvjet za liječnike koji su studij medicine upisali nakon 1. srpnja 2013. godine )
  8. Odobrenje za samostalan rad – licenca - preslika
Dokumentacija se dostavlja u neovjerenim preslikama, a izabrani kandidat dužan je nakon donošenja odluke o odabiru dostaviti na uvid originalne dokumente. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu Domu zdravlja za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi u svrhu zapošljavanja, a u skladu s odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka. Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom podnose se ili preporučenom poštanskom pošiljkom ili osobno na urudžbeni na adresu: DOM ZDRAVLJA VARAŽDINSKE ŽUPANIJE Kolodvorska 20, 42 000 Varaždin „Za javni natječaj doktor medicine specijalist pedijatrije/subspecijalist neuropedijatar '' Natječaj traje do popunjena radnog mjesta. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima sukladno posebnom propisu, dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti i dokaze utvrđene posebnim propisom iz kojih je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je vidljivo navedeno pravo, dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca, te dokaz da je nezaposlen. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi čl. 102. stavak 1-3 Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17), da bi ostvarili prednost pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima, dužni su priložiti pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja kao i sve potrebne dokaze navedene u članku 103. stavak 1. navedenog Zakona (link: Zakon o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 ) Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN broj 157/13.,152/14 i 39/18.), uz molbu na natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugi dokaz o invaliditetu. Dom zdravlja pridržava pravo za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete ovog natječaja provesti testiranje i usmeni razgovor, a o čemu će kandidati biti obaviješteni, putem internetske stranice Doma zdravlja. Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Dom zdravlja Varaždinske županije pridržava pravo, bez obrazloženja, djelomično ili u cijelosti, u svako doba poništiti natječaj bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. Rezultati izbora bit će objavljeni u zakonskom roku na oglasnoj ploči i na web-stranici Doma zdravlja Varaždinske županije.

jobs.description:
TEHNIČKA ŠKOLA ČAKOVEC

Čakovec, Športska 5

Klasa: 110-01/26-02/1

Urbroj: 2109-58-01-26-46

Čakovec, 17.8.2026.

Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školama ( NN broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23) (u daljnjem tekstu: Zakon) i Pravilnika o zapošljavanju, Odlukom Ravnatelja, Tehnička škola Čakovec, Čakovec, Športska 5, raspisuje:

NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto

Nastavnik/ica predmeta iz sektora strojarstvo ili strukovni učitelj/ica 1 u sektoru strojarstva, 1 izvršitelj/ica, neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci ili 3 mjeseca u slučaju zapošljavanja strukovnog učitelja 1.

Posebni uvjet:

  • odgovarajuća stručna sprema sukladno Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu ( NN broj 1/96, 80/99) i Kurikulu nastavnog predmeta

Svi kandidati trebaju zadovoljavati uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, Pravilnikom o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu (NN 1/1996; 80/1999.) i Kurikulom nastavnog predmeta.

Dokumentacija potrebna za prijavu na Natječaj:

  • prijava u kojoj se obavezno navodi osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela te e-mail adresa na koju će se dostaviti obavijest o datumu i vremenu procjene odnosno testiranja) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se kandidat prijavljuje
  • dokaz o traženoj stručnoj spremi/vrsti obrazovanja
  • životopis
  • dokaz o državljanstvu
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da podnositelj prijave nije pod istragom i da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje.

Svi dokumenti mogu biti u presliku ili elektroničkom zapisu, a odabrani kandidat dužan je kod zaključenja ugovora predočiti originalne dokumente te izraditi ovjereni preslik isprave o završenom obrazovanju – diplome.

Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja dužni pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju koje se provodi u skladu s odredbama Pravilnika o zapošljavanju objavljenog na sljedećoj poveznici: http://www.ss-tehnicka-ck.skole.hr/pravilnik-o-zaposljavanju-tehnicke-skole-cakovec/.

Kandidati će o vremenu i mjestu procjene i/ili testiranja biti obaviješteni putem web stranice škole ili e maila navedenog u prijavi.

Mjesto rada: Tehnička škola Čakovec, Čakovec, Športska 5

Sukladno Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova („Narodne novine“ br. 82/08 i 69/17) na natječaj se pod jednakim uvjetima mogu ravnopravno javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muške i na ženske osobe. Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe.

Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Tehnička škola Čakovec, može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati njihove osobne podatke u svrhu provedbe natječaja sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka - Opća uredba (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakon o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ broj 42/18.)

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su suglasni s javnom objavom osobnih podataka u svrhu obavještavanja o rezultatima natječaja (ime, prezime, zvanje) na internetskoj stranici Tehničke škole Čakovec.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno: članku 102. stavcima 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, br. 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20) i članku 48. stavcima 1. – 3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21.) dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja te sve dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti u skladu s posebnim propisima prema kojima isto pravo ostvaruju, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. stavcima 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji.

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje navedenog prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. stavcima 1. – 3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21.) dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja, priložiti i svu potrebnu dokumentaciju i dokaze iz članka 49. stavka 1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata.

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje navedenog prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf.

Kandidati koji se zapošljavaju u reguliranoj profesiji u sustavu odgoja i obrazovanja u Republici Hrvatskoj, a kvalifikaciju su stekli izvan Republike Hrvatske, mogu se zaposliti u odgojno-obrazovnoj ustanovi temeljem rješenja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koje izdaje Ministarstvo znanosti i obrazovanja.

Pismene prijave sa traženom dokumentacijom podnose se do 26.8.2026. do 12:00 sati na adresu Tehnička škola Čakovec, Čakovec, Športska 5 s naznakom „NATJEČAJ ZA ZASNIVANJE RADNOG ODNOSA“. Prijava kandidata mora biti zaprimljena u školi do navedenog roka bez obzira na način dostave. Svaka prijava zaprimljena nakon navedenog roka (bez obzira na način dostave – predaje poštanskoj službi) smatrat će se zakašnjelom. Nepotpune i nepravodobno poslane prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidati će o rezultatima izbora biti obaviješteni u roku od 8 dana od izbora putem e maila ili web stranice Tehničke škole Čakovec.

Dražen Blažeka, dipl. ing.

Čakovec, Športska 5

Klasa: 110-01/26-02/1

Urbroj: 2109-58-01-26-45

Čakovec, 17.8.2026.

Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školama ( NN broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23) (u daljnjem tekstu: Zakon) i Pravilnika o zapošljavanju, Odlukom Ravnatelja, Tehnička škola Čakovec, Čakovec, Športska 5, raspisuje:

NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto

Nastavnik/ica predmeta iz sektora elektrotehnike ili strukovni učitelj/ica 1 u sektoru elektrotehnike, 1 izvršitelj/ica, neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci ili 3 mjeseca u slučaju zapošljavanja strukovnog učitelja 1.

Posebni uvjet:

  • odgovarajuća stručna sprema sukladno Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu ( NN broj 1/96, 80/99) i Kurikulu nastavnog predmeta

Svi kandidati trebaju zadovoljavati uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, Pravilnikom o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu (NN 1/1996; 80/1999.) i Kurikulom nastavnog predmeta.

Dokumentacija potrebna za prijavu na Natječaj:

  • prijava u kojoj se obavezno navodi osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela te e-mail adresa na koju će se dostaviti obavijest o datumu i vremenu procjene odnosno testiranja) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se kandidat prijavljuje
  • dokaz o traženoj stručnoj spremi/vrsti obrazovanja
  • životopis
  • dokaz o državljanstvu
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da podnositelj prijave nije pod istragom i da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje.

Svi dokumenti mogu biti u presliku ili elektroničkom zapisu, a odabrani kandidat dužan je kod zaključenja ugovora predočiti originalne dokumente te izraditi ovjereni preslik isprave o završenom obrazovanju – diplome.

Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja dužni pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju koje se provodi u skladu s odredbama Pravilnika o zapošljavanju objavljenog na sljedećoj poveznici: http://www.ss-tehnicka-ck.skole.hr/pravilnik-o-zaposljavanju-tehnicke-skole-cakovec/.

Kandidati će o vremenu i mjestu procjene i/ili testiranja biti obaviješteni putem web stranice škole ili e maila navedenog u prijavi.

Mjesto rada: Tehnička škola Čakovec, Čakovec, Športska 5

Sukladno Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova („Narodne novine“ br. 82/08 i 69/17) na natječaj se pod jednakim uvjetima mogu ravnopravno javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muške i na ženske osobe. Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe.

Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Tehnička škola Čakovec, može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati njihove osobne podatke u svrhu provedbe natječaja sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka - Opća uredba (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakon o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ broj 42/18.)

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su suglasni s javnom objavom osobnih podataka u svrhu obavještavanja o rezultatima natječaja (ime, prezime, zvanje) na internetskoj stranici Tehničke škole Čakovec.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno: članku 102. stavcima 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, br. 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20) i članku 48. stavcima 1. – 3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21.) dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja te sve dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti u skladu s posebnim propisima prema kojima isto pravo ostvaruju, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. stavcima 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji.

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje navedenog prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. stavcima 1. – 3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21.) dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja, priložiti i svu potrebnu dokumentaciju i dokaze iz članka 49. stavka 1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata.

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje navedenog prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf.

Kandidati koji se zapošljavaju u reguliranoj profesiji u sustavu odgoja i obrazovanja u Republici Hrvatskoj, a kvalifikaciju su stekli izvan Republike Hrvatske, mogu se zaposliti u odgojno-obrazovnoj ustanovi temeljem rješenja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koje izdaje Ministarstvo znanosti i obrazovanja.

Pismene prijave sa traženom dokumentacijom podnose se do 26.8.2026. do 12:00 sati na adresu Tehnička škola Čakovec, Čakovec, Športska 5 s naznakom „NATJEČAJ ZA ZASNIVANJE RADNOG ODNOSA“. Prijava kandidata mora biti zaprimljena u školi do navedenog roka bez obzira na način dostave. Svaka prijava zaprimljena nakon navedenog roka (bez obzira na način dostave – predaje poštanskoj službi) smatrat će se zakašnjelom. Nepotpune i nepravodobno poslane prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidati će o rezultatima izbora biti obaviješteni u roku od 8 dana od izbora putem e maila ili web stranice Tehničke škole Čakovec.

Ravnatelj:

Dražen Blažeka, dipl. ing.

jobs.title: AUTOMEHANIČAR/KA
jobs.description:
OGLAS ZA POSAO – AUTOMEHANIČAR, AUTOMEHATRONIČAR
Vrsta zaposlenja: Stalni radni odnos / Ugovor na određeno mjesec dana, poslije neodređeno
Radno vrijeme: Puno radno vrijeme (Ponedjeljak-Petak)

Opis posla:
Zbog povećanja opsega posla tražimo odgovornu i pouzdanu osobu za radno mjesto automehaničara u našoj moderno opremljenoj radionici. Rad uključuje dijagnostiku, servisiranje i popravak osobnih i lakih gospodarskih vozila.

Glavne odgovornosti:
•Dijagnostika i otklanjanje mehaničkih kvarova
•Servisiranje i redovno održavanje vozila
•Ugradnja i zamjena autodijelova i sustava
•Vođenje evidencije o izvršenim radovima
•Održavanje alata i radnog prostora

Uvjeti:
•Završena srednja škola tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, automehatroničar)
•Minimalno 2 godine radnog iskustva u automehaničarskom poslu
•Poželjno poznavanje dijagnostičke opreme
•Odgovornost, preciznost i samostalnost u radu
•Sposobnost rada u timu
•Vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Nudimo:
•Ugovor o radu uz probni rok
•Redovita i stimulativna primanja
•Stabilno i ugodno radno okruženje
•Mogućnost stručnog usavršavanja i napredovanja
•Rad s kvalitetnim alatom i opremom

jobs.title: POŠTAR/ICA ZA EKSPRES DOSTAVU
jobs.description: OPIS POSLA Preuzimanje pošiljaka za dostavu • Sudjelovanje u pripremi pošiljaka (utovar i istovar pošiljka i zaključaka, podjela po rajonima, zaduženje i razduženje u predviđenoj aplikaciji) • Dostavljanje poštanskih pošiljaka, Paket 24 pošiljka, brzojava i novčanih doznaka te servisa • Pražnjenje poštanskih kovčežića i punjenje depoa • Obavljanje poslova razmjene zaključaka • Obavljanje poslova prijenosa i prijevoza zaključaka • Zaprimanje pošiljaka na adresi korisnika • Razduženje s dokumentacijom, neuručenim pošiljkama i novčanim sredstvima (obračun) • Prodavanje maraka, vrijednosnica, trgovačke robe i usluga iz asortimana Društva • Održavanje vozila Društva - odvoženje vozila na tehnički pregled u skladu s pripremljenom dokumentacijom, servis, popravak, zamjenu guma, pranje i čišćenje vozila • Vođenje računa o tehničkoj ispravnosti vozila u svom djelokrugu rada • Obavljanje drugih radnih zadataka koji su u skladu s naravi i vrstom poslova koje obavlja, na zahtjev neposredno nadređenog • Odgovara za provedbu poslova i radnih zadataka iz svog. Poželjno je da kandidat poznaje grad, odnosno naseljeno mjesto ovisno o području dostave Poželjne osobine kandidata: fleksibilnost, komunikativnost, usmjerenost na potrebe korisnika i ostvarivanje rezultata, sklonost timskom radu, točnost i preciznost, organiziranost, motiviranost, proaktivnost. Ako ostvarujte pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji te Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, a isto pravo želite iskoristiti, prilikom prijave nužno je dostaviti sve dokaze kojima to potvrđujete. Potrebni dokumenti mogu se pronaći na ovome linku: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843
