jobs.title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Forschung & Entwicklung
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine, and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.


Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist (m/f/d) with deep expertise in developing multi-omics data integration and machine learnings methods, to join our Digital & Data Science Group in Biologicals Research. Biologicals research discovers, characterizes, optimizes and produces novel biologicals. Biologicals are derived from nature. They can be naturally occurring microbes, extracts or molecules protecting plants from pests and diseases or improving plant and soil health.
Within this role you will work on Syngenta ‘omics data to identify patterns in product performance and make predictions. You will be asked to develop methods to analyze and interpret the outcome of ‘omics experiments with your analytical skills as well as machine learning approaches. Your work will result in new tools to guide selection, optimization and development of novel Biologicals solutions.

Key responsibilities will include:

Develop and implement new multi-omics integration strategies (e.g., data harmonization, feature engineering, network-based methods) to strengthen biological interpretation and hypothesis generation
Apply and advance machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI approaches to extract insights from complex, high‑dimensional, multi‑omics datasets
Curate, quality control, and integrate large scale ’omics datasets, ensuring data integrity, reproducibility, and downstream analytical readiness
Evaluate and develop new data analysis tools, validate findings using a trial and iterative approach, and effectively communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Identify data needs and provide recommendations to scientists to ensure the quantity and verify the integrity of data used for analyses
Work collaboratively to deliver new approaches, share learnings, and drive innovation in digital and data science including technology foresight
Work with R&D IT and software developers to deploy predictive model applications tailored to stakeholder needs
Support business users with change management initiatives to manage data more effectively

Qualifications:

MSc or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, or related field with some experience in natural sciences (e.g. chemical biology, microbiology, ecology, environmental sciences)
3+ years developing multi-omics integration methods for complex biological, biochemical, environmental, or agricultural datasets
Strong proficiency in Python and/or R, UNIX/Linux environments, ML frameworks, SQL
Experience with proteomics and metabolomics data analysis would be an asset
Dynamic personality with passion for innovation and problem-solving

Additional information:

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

A position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits such as Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance
Please send your complete application with CV, a motivation letter that highlights your motivation and relevant experience for this position, diploma and work certificates (if applicable) in English. Additionally, we welcome access to git repositories showcasing relevant past projects. We will only consider applications that contain CV and motivation letters.

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

In this role, you own the Trade Compliance framework for the Local Business Line (LBL) and are accountable for establishing, implementing, and continuously improving the policies, processes, controls, and governance required to ensure compliant execution of our global business activities. You ensure that all international business transactions, project deliveries, imports, exports, cross-border shipments, and related trade activities are conducted in accordance with ABB's Global Trade Program and applicable customs, export control, sanctions, and origin regulations. As the LBL's Trade Compliance authority, you define and maintain the operational trade compliance framework. You establish clear processes, responsibilities, controls, and escalation mechanisms and ensure effective implementation across all relevant functions. You drive the integration of trade compliance requirements into daily operations and act as the main point for complex compliance matters, regulatory changes, and risk mitigation. You are further responsible for developing, documenting, and maintaining procedures and training programs related to export controls, sanctions, customs, and origin management.

Develop, improve and implement processes of LBL’s customs procedures, origin management, sanction lists screening, dual-use classification and export controls.

Functionally lead trade compliance resources in the LBL.

Lead and oversee Trade Compliance within the Local Business Line (LBL), including the implementation and continuous improvement of ABB’s Trade Compliance Program, internal directives, internal control system, local trade reviews, self-audits, and corrective actions.

Provide expert guidance and training on customs, origin, export control, and sanctions compliance, supporting the LBL, coordinating trade compliance resources and support functions, and maintaining strong alignment with key stakeholders such as CTCO, TCS, PCE, declarants, and logistics teams.

Drive Trade Compliance in day-to-day operations and complex projects, including risk assessments, internal checks, master data and supplier-related compliance requirements, and regular updates to stakeholders on implementation progress and relevant regulatory changes.

Advise and drive all trade compliance matters in LBL’s complex projects to different countries


What we are looking for:

Degree as a Foreign Trade Specialist / Manager or Export Control / Customs Compliance Officer with at least 8 years of experience in a relevant field (Senior Trade Compliance or Legal/Compliance background)

Excellent experience in free trade and preferential origins as well as in trade compliance matters

Solid knowledge in Swiss (GKV), EU and US (EAR) dual-use and sanctions regulations

Experience in an industry with large project businesses in various countries and ability as a people leader and solution-oriented team player

SAP and SAP GTS E4H experiences

Fluent in English, German is a plus

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry- specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment.  Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

jobs.title: Doctoral Researchers in Literary Studies or History (Verses of Learning: Epideixis and Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities)/ 1–2 Väitöskirjatutkijaa, kirjallisuustiede tai historia
jobs.description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences) at Tampere University invites applications for

1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history. The duration of employment is determined by the progress of the doctoral studies and thesis work and is limited up to a maximum of four years, starting in January 2027 or as agreed.

The positions are open within Academy Professor Sari Kivistös project, [The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities (VERSITAS)](https://projects.tuni.fi/versitas/in-english/), funded by the Research Council of Finland (2026-2031). The project examines the relationships between poetry, rhetoric, and nature in the early modern period, as well as their roots and continuities in earlier and later centuries. Myths and cultural narratives were an important part of early modern natural history and shaped experiences of nature. The project argues that understanding nature from a cultural perspective requires attention to the literary forms, genres, and rhetorical strategies through which it was represented. Through the study of scientific writing and occasional literature from the early modern period and adjacent centuries, we investigate how literary and stylistic devices shape relationships between humans and nature. Based in the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University, the project offers a supportive and inspiring working environment, as well as excellent opportunities for researchers to advance their skills and careers.

Positions and Qualifications

We are seeking promising doctoral researchers with a masters degree in a relevant field within the humanities (e.g., literary studies, rhetoric and its history, book history, intellectual history, or classical studies). Applicants will be assessed primarily on the suitability of their proposed research topic to the projects aims and its potential to produce research of high international standard. Knowledge of early modern literature and/or history, as well as experience working with historical texts and archival materials, will be considered an asset. Possible dissertation topics include historical studies of nature, human-animal studies, and ecocritical approaches to pre-modern and early modern literature, with potential scope for transhistorical perspectives. Familiarity with the history of rhetoric or occasional poetry will also be considered an advantage.

The doctoral researchers will be responsible for writing a doctoral dissertation related to the projects research themes and completing the credits required for the doctoral degree. They will collaborate with the research team in organizing joint events and participating in other academic activities. The appointed researchers will contribute to teaching and administrative duties for up to 5% of their working time.

The selected candidates must apply for and be admitted to Tampere Universitys [Doctoral Programme in Literary Studies](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-literary-studies) or [Doctoral Programme in History](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-history) during the autumn semester of 2026. The application period for these programmes runs from 1 to 30 October 2026.

We offer

The positions are fixed term for four years (or a shorter period, depending on the stage of the dissertation) and will begin in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

Salary is based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). Doctoral Researchers are placed on levels 2-4 of the salary scale. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary is approximately €2,700 per month and will increase as the doctoral studies progress.

The appointees are expected to reside in Finland during their employment at Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us) and explore our [Career Stories.](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us/career-stories)

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).

How to apply

Applications must be submitted in English through Tampere Universitys electronic recruitment system (link below). The closing date for applications is 11 September 2026 (at 23:59/UTC+3). Online interviews with shortlisted candidates will be held on 22 and 23 September 2026.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

1) CV (max. 3 pages, including a list of publications, if applicable, and the contact details of the supervisor of your masters thesis)

2) Reference letter from the prospective supervisor of the doctoral dissertation (if external to the research team)

3) Preliminary research proposal (max. 3 pages), including

- a description of your previous research experience (e.g., your masters thesis);
- a research idea outlining why the projects themes or approach interest you and how you would position your doctoral research within this context;
- a timeline for your doctoral studies.

Please be prepared to provide proof of your qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated research proposals.

Enquiries

For further information about the position, please contact the project PI, Academy Professor Sari Kivistö, sari.kivisto(at)tuni.fi.

️ Hvad skal du lave?

Som mekaniker får du en alsidig hverdag med både klargøring og tekniske opgaver. Dine primære arbejdsområder vil være:

 

  • ✅ Reparation og servicering af kundescootere

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har teknisk snilde og evt. erfaring fra værksted eller lignende

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og går op i kvalitet

  • Trives med både rutineprægede og varierende opgaver

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt i et team

  • Er fleksibel og klar til at tage fat, når der er travlt

Erfaring med el-køretøjer eller reparation er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En spændende hverdag med masser af ansvar og variation

  • Et uformelt og hjælpsomt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og en arbejdsplads i vækst

Om Lindebjerg

DEN GODE SERVICE ER DET VIGTIGSTE FOR OS
Det er vores fornemste opgave at have tilfredse kunder. Dette opnår vi ved at sætte vores kunder i centrum ved altid at være service minded, have top engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere, sælge kvalitetsprodukter, samt altid at være omstillingsparate, så vi kan tilpasse os vores kunders behov.

Lindebjerg er blandt landets absolut førende leverandører af el-køretøjer indenfor vores branche. Vi har solgt mere end 15000 køretøjer, som i dag kører på de danske landeveje.

Virksomheden er landsdækkende. Vores hovedkontor er placeret i Middelfart og lokationen råder over hele 2600 kvadratmeter fordelt på showroom, lager, værksted og administration. Udover vores hovedkontor, har vi showrooms fordelt i hele Danmark, derved kan vi altid være tæt på vores kunder. Vi er netop i gang med åbning af to nye showrooms, herudover har vi lokationer i Aabenraa, Esbjerg, Holstebro, Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense, Sorø, Hillerød og København.

Työssä korostuvat läsnäolo, kohtaamisen taito ja yksilöllinen ohjaus

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos olet helposti lähestyttävä, kärsivällinen ja aidosti kiinnostunut kohtaamaan erilaisia ihmisiä. Osaat toimia asiakkaan rinnalla kannustavasti ja hänen yksilöllisiä tarpeitaan kuunnellen. Sinulle on luontevaa tukea asiakkaan osallistumista arjen toimintoihin, harrastuksiin ja sosiaalisiin tilanteisiin sekä löytää yhdessä uusia mahdollisuuksia mielekkääseen tekemiseen.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES

- Joustavan työajan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Sosiaalialan koulutusta

- Kiinnostusta vammaistyöhön

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

- Selkeää vuorovaikutusta, läsnäoloa ja itsenäistä työotetta


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. EOT-tukihenkilön tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.

Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. jobs.title: PhD-fellowship
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applicants for a four-year position as a PhD research fellow at the Institute of Psychology, Faculty of Social Sciences at the University of Oslo. The position is associated with the interdisciplinary project: «Decoding addiction», funded by a UiO Life Science grant. 

The candidate would join the “Project knockout” team and conduct laboratory testing of pain, reward, and stress in a newly discovered human genetic knockout model population. Data analysis of large-scale registry data comparing mutation carriers to non-carriers is also part of the project, which aims to generate novel insights into human endogenous opioid function.

The position is full-time for a fixed-term of four years and includes 25% career promoting work, which may consist of teaching, dissemination, and contribution to other activities at the Department. Start date: summer/autumn 2026. 


More about the position

The project studies how Opioid analgesics are powerful medical tools with the potential to cause terrible side effects. Because their effects are so variable across individuals and contexts, many key debates remain unsettled in the field. Improved understanding of endogenous opioid functions in the healthy human brain is urgently needed. 

While it is well known that opioid drugs interfere with the many functions endogenous opioids serve throughout the brain and body, current understanding relies too heavily on extrapolation from rodent studies and non-specific pharmacology in humans. Notably, genetically engineered ‘knockout’ mice that lack the mu-opioid receptor gene (OPRM1) have revealed the opioid-dependence of e.g. pain and stress regulation. Moreover, an OPRM1 genetic dose response was found for reward by comparing knockouts to heterozygous knockdown mice with few mu-opioid receptors. The project centers on a newly discovered human OPRM1 knockout/knockdown model to probe human endogenous opioid function with a precision far exceeding existing antagonist studies in the field. 

The project offers opportunities to develop unique competence in behavioral genetics, experimental psychology and psychopharmacology, whilst working in an ambitious yet friendly and collaborative, interdisciplinary environment. The research group comprises affective and social neuroscience, psychology, anesthesiology, and other disciplines and specializes in the study of pain, reward, stress, and addiction. The candidate will participate in study design, data collection, analysis, and publications in close collaboration with other team members and under the guidance of Siri Leknes. Further details about the project are available upon request.


Your main tasks will be:
  • Help finalize and validate test setup for pain, stress, and reward tasks
  • Contribute to recruitment, data collection and analysis of experimental data
  • Contribute to gaining access to and data analysis of registry data including genetic information, e.g. from MoBa, UK Biobank, Hunt, and other relevant registries
  • Maintain good collaboration within the Knockout team and across the disciplines represented in the broader Decode project
  • First author papers summarizing and interpreting insights from experimental and registry data, taking into account insights from the preclinical and basic science parts of the Decode project

The PhD fellow will take part in the approved PhD program at the Department of Psychology. The main purpose of the PhD fellowship is to qualify the candidate for a research career within or beyond academia. To support a strategic and well-structured PhD trajectory, the PhD fellow will be required to develop a career and competence development plan in dialogue with the supervisory team early in the appointment period.


What skills are important in this role?
  • Applicants must hold a medical degree or a Masters in psychology, neuroscience, or a closely related field. 
     
  • To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow, admission to a doctoral program is required, or there must be a binding agreement for admission. Read about admission to the Faculty's PhD program here: https://www.sv.uio.no/english/research/phd/application/phd-fellowship/
     
  • Documented research experience relevant to the project is a requirement. This may come from a master’s thesis, research assistantship, or other comparable research activity, for example in psychopharmacology, computational neuroscience, experimental psychology, functional imaging, or behavioral genetics.
     
  • Coding skills and experience with statistical modelling are a strong advantage.
     
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English are required.

The cover letter must include brief reflections on the implementation of this behavioral genetics study. For instance, you could reflect on the choice of tasks that could be used to test pain, stress, or reward sensitivity. Alternatively, provide a brief sketch of an analysis plan for data extracted from suitable databases, ideas for statistical analysis comparing single-case/small-group mutation carriers to controls, or discuss a different aspect of the project that engages your curiosity. 


What are we looking for in you?
  • Strong motivation and organizational skills.
     
  • Ability to think creatively within a scientific framework.
     
  • Your personal suitability and motivation for the position, including enthusiasm, flexibility, curiosity, and a strong ability to collaborate as part of a larger research team.
     
  • Previous research and interest in the above-mentioned themes, e.g. reward, stress, addiction, pain, opioids. Proven ability to work independently and efficiently on relevant research topics.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications

jobs.title: Tarjoilija
jobs.description:

Etsimme nyt tiimiimme tarjoilijaa 60h sopimuksella, mutta sesonki aikaan työvuoroja on tarjolla enemmänkin. Tässä tehtävässä tärkeintä on aito kiinnostus asiakaspalveluun – nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta, olet aidosti läsnä asiakkaalle ja haluat omalla tekemiselläsi luoda lämpimän, välittömän ja laadukkaan RUNO-kokemuksen.

Työ painottuu pääsääntöisesti aamu- ja päivävuoroihin erityisesti viikonloppuina ja pyhäpäivinä, mutta työvuoroja on tarjolla myös arkipäivisin ja satunnaisesti myös iltapainotteisesti. Tehtävässä työskentelet monipuolisesti aina hotelliaamiaisista ja viikonloppubrunsseista lounaisiin ja erilaisiin tilaisuuksiin. Päivääsi kuuluu asiakkaiden vastaanottamista ja palvelemista, ruoka- ja juomatarjoilua sekä buffetin ja salin sujuvasta toiminnasta huolehtimista. Lisäksi vastaat kassasta, päivittäisistä valmisteluista sekä avaus- ja sulkutehtävistä ja työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä keittiön ja muun tiimin kanssa.

Toivomme sinulta:

- vähintään 2 vuoden aikaisempaa kokemusta ravintola-alalta

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, ruotsin kielen taitoa pidämme suurena etuna

- asiakaslähtöistä ja positiivista asennetta

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua tehdä hyvää yhteistyötä muun tiimin kanssa

- kiinnostusta laadukkaaseen palveluun ja halua tehdä asiakkaan päivästä hieman paremman.


Tarjoamme sinulle nuoren, kunnianhimoisen ja välittävän työympäristön, jossa haluamme jatkuvasti kehittää tekemistämme ja luoda Suomen parhaisiin kuuluvia hotellin ja ravintolan elämyksiä. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen tiimin jäsen pääsee vaikuttamaan, oppimaan ja kasvamaan osana yhteisöä. Palkkauksessa noudatetaan matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevaa työntekijöiden työehtosopimusta, jossa otetaan huomioon aikaisempi kokemus.

Jos olet energinen, oma-aloitteinen ja aidosti asiakaspalveluhenkinen sekä haluat olla mukana luomassa RUNOn vieraille hetkiä, jotka jäävät mieleen, haluamme kuulla sinusta!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Vil du også være på den grønne gren?
jobs.description:
Er du uddannet pædagog, kan levere varmt nærvær i børnehøjde og være fagligt reflekterende i dit arbejde, er det dig vi leder efter

Om os

Akvariefisk, ulveskov og hverdagspædagogik er nogle af de ting, som findes i Børnehuset Derudá, hvor vi leder efter en pædagog til vores vuggestue nærmere bestemt Den Grønne Gren.

Her vil blandt andet David og Lene være dine nærmeste kollegaer. De er blandt meget andet 100 meter mestre i organisering, og har godt styr på overblikket. De er også meget åbne for dine idéer, hvis du har noget, som du brænder for pædagogisk.

Vi er et stort hus med med mulighed for åbne døre, men også med plads til ro og fordybelse bag en lukket dør til små grupper og større fællesskaber. Vi er både fælles og hver for sig.

Vi har en meget stor legeplads, hvor vuggestuen og børnehaven færdes frit. Her er svævebane, bålplads og et utal af krat, træer og gemmesteder til børnene.

Husets hjerte er køkkenfællesrummet, der binder vuggestuen og børnehaven sammen. Hver afdeling har også eget fællesrum, som vi i vuggestuen bruger til leg, musik og bevægelse.

Vuggestuen består af tre stuer (Orange Scene, Blåhvalen og Den Grønne Gren) med 11 børn på hver stue. Der går en hæk ned gennem vores legeplads, og ud fra hver vuggestue er der en lille gårdhave, hvor man bedre kan lave en afgrænset pædagogisk aktivitet. 

Vi tilbyder 

  • En arbejdsplads der vægter høj faglighed og sætter kerneopgaven i fokus. 
  • Tid til faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling.
  • En medarbejdergruppe som er optaget af at evaluere på egen praksis og skabe endnu bedre lege- og læringsmiljøer.
  • En vuggestue, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på strukturen og aktiviteter og være med til at udvikle praksis. 
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af huset. 
  • En masse dejlige børn og familier.
  • Koncentration i arbejdet med dagtilbud for alle og fokus på refleksion og evalueringskultur.
  • En fastansat sprogkonsulent i dagtilbuddet, som vi sparrer meget med.
  • Mulighed for at skifte stue eller afdeling, hvis opgaven kalder på det, eller man har ønske om det.
  • Opbakning til kurser og efteruddannelser.

Vi synes, det er fedt hvis du:

  • Formår at skabe gode læringsmiljøer og deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene og altid har fokus på kerneopgaven og barnets perspektiv – både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet.
  • Interesserer dig for børnenes intentioner og møder dem anerkendende og åbent samt er nysgerrig på, hvad der ligger bag deres handlinger.
  • Aktivt medvirker til udvikling, planlægning, gennemføring, evaluering og dokumentering af pædagogiske forløb.
  • Kan bringe dig selv i spil, gå forrest og give følgeskab, i dagligdagen og i samarbejdet med kollegaer og forældre.
  • Kan lide at lege og forstår vigtigheden af voksen indlevelse og deltagelse i børns leg.
  • Kan kommunikere professionelt med forældre, kollegaer og ledelse og ønsker at sparre, så vi sikrer god kvalitet.  
  • Er smilende og imødekommende, og at du er bevidst om, at du er en vigtig rollemodel i mange forskellige sammenhænge.

Ansøgning

Vi er ikke så vilde med traditionelle ansøgninger, og måske er du heller ikke. Derfor ønsker vi, at du sender et dokument, hvor du svarer på disse 5 spørgsmål. Svarene vil give os et bedre indblik i dig som pædagog og din faglighed.

  1. Fortæl om et barn, du havde svært ved at skabe relation til. Hvad gjorde du? Og hvad lærte du?
  2. Hvad er god pædagogik i en vuggestue efter din mening?
  3. Hvordan balancerer du omsorg og tydelige rammer?
  4. Hvilken rolle mener du, den voksen skal have i børns leg?
  5. Fortæl om noget, du har ændret mening om i dit pædagogiske arbejde gennem tiden og hvorfor. 

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansættelsen er pr. 1. oktober 2026 men også gerne før.

Ansøgningsfrist:  18.09.2026
 
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Kan du se dig selv i noget af ovenstående, eller har du nogle spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Mette Hornemann på 23 37 20 27 eller på hornemann@aarhus.dk. Du kan også kontakte David – der er pædagog på Den Grønne Gren på 21266592.

Se mere om os på vores hjemmeside Børnehuset Derudá

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

jobs.title: HR-suunnittelija
jobs.description:
Etsitkö monipuolista HR-tehtävää, jossa pääset tukemaan esihenkilöitä, ratkomaan henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä ja työskentelemään erilaisten HR-prosessien ja järjestelmien parissa? Tässä tehtävässä saat vastuullesi vaihtelevia kokonaisuuksia ja pääset myös kehittämään yhteisiä toimintatapoja yhdessä muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Haemme nyt HR-suunnittelijaa Helsingin kaupunginkansliaan vakituiseen tehtävään. Tehtävän aloitus 1.10. tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Mitä pääset tässä roolissa tekemään?

Työpäiväsi HR-suunnittelijana koostuvat henkilöstöhallinnon neuvonnasta, päätösvalmistelusta, koordinoinnista ja kehittämisestä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä esihenkilöiden, HR-asiantuntijoiden ja kaupungin yhteisten palveluiden kanssa.

Tehtävässäsi:

- neuvot esihenkilöitä henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksissä ja autat heitä löytämään oikeat toimintatavat ja palvelut

- käsittelet HR:lle tulevia henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä ja ohjaat niitä tarvittaessa oikeille asiantuntijoille

- valmistelet kaupunginkanslian ylimmän johdon henkilöstöhallintoon liittyviä päätöksiä ja huolehdit niiden etenemisestä palkanmaksuun

- tuet esihenkilöitä työaikajärjestelmän ja työaikakäytäntöjen käytössä sekä vastaat työaika- ja ylityöraportoinnista palkanmaksun aikataulujen mukaisesti

- osallistut työaikajärjestelmän kehittämiseen osana kaupunkitasoista yhteistyötä

- hoidat henkilöstöhallinnon prosesseja, jotka liittyvät esimerkiksi A1-todistuksiin, siviilipalvelukseen ja palvelusvuosiin

- toimit tarvittaessa Workday-pääkäyttäjän sijaisena

- osallistut HR-tiimin yhteiseen kehittämiseen sekä kokousten ja tilaisuuksien koordinointiin.

Tehtävässä menestymisen eväät

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos innostut käytännönläheisestä HR-työstä ja erilaisten henkilöstöhallinnon kysymysten ratkomisesta. Toivomme, että sinulla on:

- Kokemusta henkilöstöhallinnon tehtävistä tai henkilöstöprosesseista. Työehtosopimusten ja työlainsäädännön tulkitseminen ei aiheuta sinulle harmaita hiuksia - jos KVTES ja kunta-ala ovat sinulle entuudestaan tuttuja, olemme erityisen vaikuttuneita!

- Kykyä selvittää henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä itsenäisesti ja soveltaa osaamistasi erilaisissa tilanteissa. Tartut uusiinkin kysymyksiin rohkeasti ja etsit niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.

- Kykyä hallita useita samanaikaisia tehtäviä ja organisoida omaa työtäsi. Pidät langat käsissäsi ja huolehdit siitä, että sovitut asiat etenevät loppuun asti.

- Selkeä ja sujuva tapa viestiä. Osaat sanoittaa henkilöstöhallinnon asioita ymmärrettävästi eri kohderyhmille ja neuvot esihenkilöitä luontevasti erilaisissa tilanteissa.

- Mutkaton tapa tehdä yhteistyötä. Autat mielelläsi muita, jaat osaamistasi ja arvostat avointa kommunikointia.

- Sujuvaa digiosaamista ja valmiutta ottaa haltuun uusia HR-järjestelmiä. Workday-HR-järjestelmän tuntemus ja kokemus työaikajärjestelmistä ovat tässä tehtävässä plussaa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto sekä suomen kielen erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Pääset osaksi osaavaa, palvelualtista ja rempseää HR-tiimiä, jossa yhdeksänhenkinen porukka tukee ja auttaa sinua onnistumaan työtehtävissäsi. Joustoa työn tekemiseen tarjoaa liukuva työaika ja mahdollisuus etätyöskentelyyn - teemme töitä monipaikkaisesti, mutta iloitsemme erityisesti kohdatessamme toimistollamme. Viihtyisät toimitilamme sijaitsevat historiaa havisevassa kaupungintalon korttelissa.

Tehtävän määritelty peruspalkka on 3498,42 e/kk + KVTES:in mukainen työkokemuslisä 3 tai 8 %. Helsingin kaupungin työntekijänä saat myös runsaasti erilaisia henkilöstöetuja. Kaupunki tarjoaa muun muassa laadukkaita työterveyshuollon palveluja, henkilöstökassan jäsenyyden, runsaasti liikkumiseen ja vapaa-aikaan liittyviä etuja sekä kaupunkipyörä- ja työsuhdematkalippuedun. Suurena työnantajana tarjoamme monia mahdollisuuksia ammattitaidon kehittämiseen, kuten kattavan koulutustarjonnan sekä monenlaisia urapolkuja.

Innostuitko?

Tartu rohkeasti tilaisuuteen ja jätä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 31.8.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat henkilöstöpäällikkö Taru Wickströmiltä (+358504331004) Parhaiten saat Tarun kiinni joko ke 19.8. klo 13.30-15.30 tai pe 21.8. klo 13.30-15.30.

Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Projektleder/værkfører til lastbilopbygninger
jobs.description:
SAWO HERLEV

Projektleder/værkfører til lastbilopbygninger

Vil du bygge nogle af Danmarks mest spændende lastbilopbygninger – og samtidig være den, der får projekter, mennesker og værksted til at spille sammen?

En central rolle med ansvar fra ordre til færdig lastbil – tæt på både kunderne, medarbejderne og de tekniske løsninger.

Tag styringen fra ordre til aflevering

SAWO er Danmarks førende specialist i opbygninger og udstyr til lastbiler og entreprenørkøretøjer. Til vores afdeling i Herlev søger vi en projektleder/værkfører, der kan kombinere teknisk forståelse, projektstyring og daglig ledelse.

Du bliver bindeleddet mellem kunden, salg, konstruktion, værksted og leverandører. Din opgave er at skabe overblik, sikre fremdrift og give medarbejderne de bedste forudsætninger for at levere den kvalitet, SAWO er kendt for.

Dit ansvar

Du får ansvar for hele forløbet – ikke kun for tidsplanen:

·     Planlægge og styre opbygningsprojekter fra ordre til færdig lastbil

·     Sikre fremdrift, kvalitet og økonomi i projekterne

·     Planlægge værkstedets daglige arbejde og fordele opgaverne

·     Følge op på tidsplaner, materialer, indkøb og leverancer

·     Koordinere med kunder, sælgere, konstruktører og leverandører

·     Håndtere ændringer og udfordringer, før de vokser sig store

·     Sikre en professionel kvalitetssikring og aflevering

·     Deltage praktisk og teknisk, når situationen kræver det

Du ejer processen

Ordre → planlægning → indkøb → produktion → kvalitet → aflevering

Samtidig er du den daglige leder på værkstedet. Du skaber struktur, prioriterer opgaverne og sørger for, at alle ved, hvad der skal ske – også når virkeligheden ændrer planen. For det gør den jo indimellem på et værksted.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Din uddannelsestitel er ikke det afgørende. Du kan komme fra et værksted, produktion, opbygning, lastbiler eller en anden teknisk branche. Det vigtige er, at du kan skabe struktur, forstå teknikken og trives med ansvar.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

·     har erfaring med projektledelse, koordinering eller styring af større opgaver

·     kan læse og forstå tekniske tegninger

·     kommunikerer tydeligt med kunder, medarbejdere, leverandører og kolleger

·     forstår, at tid, kvalitet og økonomi skal balanceres

·     handler løsningsorienteret, når der opstår udfordringer

·     bevarer overblikket, når mange ting er i gang samtidig

·     har lyst til at være tæt på både menneskerne og det praktiske arbejde

Erfaring med lastbiler, kraner, hydraulik eller opbygninger er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Teknisk forståelse, struktur og lysten til at tage ansvar vejer tungest.

Derfor skal du vælge SAWO

·     En central nøgleposition – du får reel indflydelse på både projekter og værkstedsdrift.

·     Teknik og ledelse i samme job – du bliver ikke parkeret bag et skrivebord hele dagen.

·     Plads til at præge arbejdet – du kan være med til at udvikle måden, vi gennemfører opbygningsprojekter på.

·     Stærkt fagligt fællesskab – du får dygtige kolleger og specialister omkring dig.

·     En virksomhed med tyngde – mere end 60 års erfaring, landsdækkende service og stor efterspørgsel.

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Siden 1962 har vi skabt driftssikre og skræddersyede løsninger. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed og respekt for godt håndværk. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

Klar til næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Oliver Cox på oco@sawo.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til rollen eller hverdagen i Herlev, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Oliver Cox på telefon 27 74 76 81.

ARBEJDSSTED

Knapholm 8, 2730 Herlev

TILTRÆDELSE

Hurtigst muligt

KONTAKT

Oliver Cox · oco@sawo.dk · 27 74 76 81

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Lastbilopbygger til vores værksted
jobs.description:
SAWO ODENSE

Lastbilopbygger til vores værksted

Har du hænderne skruet rigtigt på – og brænder du for at bygge løsninger, der skal fungere ude på vejen?

Specialopbygninger, tekniske udfordringer og synligt håndværk – her får du lov til at bruge hele din faglighed.

Byg løsninger – ikke samlebånd

SAWO er Danmarks førende specialist i opbygninger og udstyr til lastbiler og entreprenørkøretøjer. Til vores værksted i Odense søger vi en dygtig lastbilopbygger, der vil være med til at skabe kundetilpassede løsninger af høj kvalitet.

Hos os er der ikke tale om masseproduktion. Den ene dag bygger du måske et nyt lad; den næste monterer du en kran, hydraulik, værktøjskasser eller en specialløsning. Du følger ofte bilen fra de første dele af opbygningen, til den står færdig og klar til kunden.

Dine opgaver

·   Opbygge lastbiler efter kundespecifikke løsninger

·   Montere kraner, hydrauliske komponenter, værktøjskasser og andet udstyr

·   Fremstille og montere lad, sider, rammer og beslag

·   Svejsning, skæring, boring samt andet smede- og montagearbejde

·   Tilpasse og modificere eksisterende opbygninger

·   Fejlfinde, løse tekniske udfordringer og færdiggøre biler til kunden

·   Kvalitetskontrollere dit eget arbejde og sikre en flot, sikker aflevering

Du får lov til at bruge din faglighed

Tegningen viser ikke altid hele løsningen. Undervejs kan du skulle vurdere, hvordan en komponent bedst monteres, hvordan en konstruktion skal tilpasses, eller hvordan den ønskede funktion kommer til at virke sikkert og holdbart i praksis.

Lastbiler → kraner → hydraulik → stål → aluminium → montage → problemløsning

Det er netop variationen, der gør arbejdet spændende – og tilfredsstillelsen stor, når du ser den færdige lastbil køre ud ad porten og ved: Den har jeg været med til at bygge.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du kan være uddannet lastvognsmekaniker, smed, klejnsmed, industrimontør, hydrauliktekniker, karrosseritekniker eller entreprenør-/landbrugsmaskinmekaniker. Du kan også have opbygget tilsvarende kompetencer gennem solid praktisk erfaring.

Det afgørende er ikke den præcise titel på dit uddannelsesbevis. Det vigtigste er, at du kan dit håndværk, tager ansvar og har lyst til at bygge noget, der skal fungere i den virkelige verden.

·   arbejder selvstændigt og har sans for detaljer og finish

·   finder løsninger, når opgaven ikke går helt efter planen

·   samarbejder naturligt med kolleger, værkfører og projektleder

·   har fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet og korrekt udførelse

·   har erfaring med lastbilopbygninger, kraner, hydraulik eller montage – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Erfaring er godt – men håndværket, nysgerrigheden og lysten til at finde den rigtige løsning vejer tungest.

Derfor skal du vælge SAWO

·   Specialopgaver frem for samlebånd – din arbejdsdag bliver varieret, og løsningerne kan ses.

·   Plads til faglighed – du får ansvar og mulighed for at præge den praktiske løsning.

·   Stærkt fagligt fællesskab – du får dygtige kolleger og specialister omkring dig.

·   Udvikling i jobbet – vi tilbyder kurser og mulighed for at opbygge nye specialkompetencer.

·   Gode rammer – moderne værkstedsfaciliteter, nødvendigt værktøj og ordnede forhold.

·   En virksomhed med tyngde – mere end 60 års erfaring, landsdækkende service og stor efterspørgsel.

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Siden 1962 har vi skabt driftssikre og skræddersyede løsninger. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed og respekt for godt håndværk. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

Klar til næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Patrick Probst, Værkstedschef, på pap@sawo.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet eller hverdagen i Odense, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Patrick på telefon 21716890.

ARBEJDSSTED

Hvidkærvej 46, 5250 Odense SV

TILTRÆDELSE

Hurtigst muligt

KONTAKT

Patrick Probst · pap@sawo.dk · 21716890

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer
PhD Research Fellow in Meteorology
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a position as PhD Research Fellow in Meteorology available at Department of Geoscience.

Starting date as soon as possible. 

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year maybe considered and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is Section for Meteorology and Oceanography in the Department of Geoscience at Blindern, Oslo.


Job description

This PhD position is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the project EEIwarm, which seeks to better understand the acceleration in global warming in recent years, and particularly the surge in warming from 2023 – 2025. Specifi-cally, the project will investigate the physical underpinnings of the heat surge and its persistence, with particular emphasis on Earth’s energy imbalance (EEI) and ocean heat content (OHC), in order to close an existing knowledge gap and im-prove near-term predictions. Other partners in the project are University of Ber-gen and Nansen Environmental and Remote Sensing Center (NERSC, project leaders), and researchers from ETH-Zürich in Switzerland are international collab-orators.

The primary research tool in the project is the Norwegian Earth System Model, vesion 3 (NorESM3), and a central satellite dataset for EEI is from the Clouds and the Earth’s Radiant Energy System (CERES). The specific tasks intended for the PhD fellow are to (i) Analyze observational datasets to quantify cloud and radia-tive flux variations associated with the rapid warming of 2023 - 2025, (ii) Apply atmosphere-only NorESM3 simulations to explore drivers of the rapid warming (iii) Diagnose atmosphere-only and coupled NorESM3 simulations to link cloud processes and EEI anomalies to the rapid warming.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Meteorology or a related field
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and ideally also in a Scandinavian language
  • Relevant experience in analyzing output from, and ideally also running, weather and/or climate models
  • Strong programming skills and experience working with large (simuated or observed) data sets

Desired qualifications:

  • Familiarity with NorESM and/or CERES data

Language requirement:

  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and ideally also in a Scandinavian language
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The geosciences are the studies of the planet Earth and its comparative planetology; the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and cryosphere, the Earth's surface and its interior. The Department of Geosciences conducts research and teaching in most of the domains of geoscience; geology, geophysics, physical geography, geomatics, hydrology, meteorology and oceanography. The Department is the broadest geoscience research and education environment in Norway. We perform research at a high international standard and have five ERC (European Research Council) research projects ongoing.

The Department encompasses six scientific sections; Meteorology and Oceanography, Geography and Hydrology, Study of sedimentary basins, Environmental geosciences. and Crustal Processes. We host now a third in the line of three Centre of Excellences:  PHAB – Centre for Planetary Habitability, and have a Norwegian Research School for PhD students (Research School for Dynamics and Evolution of Earth and Planets, DEEP).

The Department aims to contribute to the new and important UN Sustainability Development Goals, and are important contributors to IPCC (UN’s Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change). The staff consists of 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, researchers, technical- and administrative staff. The Department has around 200 employees.

Levyseppähitsaaja Eurajoelle

Etsimme Eurajoelle levyseppähitsaajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, jolla on jo kokemusta levyseppähitsauksen työtehtävistä ja halu kehittää omaa osaamistaan myös polttoleikkauksen parissa.

Työ sisältää monipuolisia levysepän tehtäviä, kuten levyjen käsittelyä ja työstöä, kappaleiden sovitusta ja kokoonpanoa sekä muita metalliteollisuuden valmistukseen liittyviä työtehtäviä. Työsuhteen edetessä työnkuvaan tulee mukaan myös polttoleikkausta, johon perehdytetään tarvittaessa.

Odotamme sinulta aikaisempaa kokemusta levyseppähitsauksen tehtävistä, huolellista työotetta sekä kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti. Englannin kielen taito on tehtävässä tärkeä, sillä työympäristössä kommunikoidaan myös englanniksi. Aikaisempi kokemus polttoleikkauksesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta sitä ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi.

jobs.title: Assisterende serviceleder til Aarhus – er du god til mennesker og har blik for kvalitet?
jobs.description:
Vil du have en hverdag, hvor du er tæt på medarbejderne, følger op på kvaliteten og er med til at få den daglige drift til at fungere?

Vi søger en assisterende serviceleder til Aarhus-området, som trives med ansvar, mennesker og en arbejdsdag, hvor du er meget ude i driften.

Stillingen er på 30-37 timer om ugen, primært om eftermiddagen og aftenen. Du møder typisk omkring kl. 14.30, men arbejdstiden kan variere.

Din hverdag hos os

Du bliver en vigtig støtte for både medarbejdere og ledelse. Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • føre tilsyn og følge op på kvaliteten hos vores kunder

  • oplære, instruere og følge op på medarbejdere

  • sikre, at medarbejderne har de rette rammer for at løse deres opgaver

  • reagere på de udfordringer, der opstår i den daglige drift

  • hjælpe med mindre administrative opgaver, bl.a. i forbindelse med løn

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er god til at skabe relationer og naturligt tager ansvar. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, bevare overblikket og kommunikere tydeligt med forskellige mennesker.

Erfaring fra rengøring, service eller en lignende rolle er en fordel, men for os er din tilgang til mennesker og kvalitet mindst lige så vigtig.

Du skal have kørekort B.

Det får du hos Toma

Du får en selvstændig og varieret stilling med stor kontakt til medarbejderne og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i hverdagen.

Hos Toma lægger vi vægt på ordentlighed, ansvarlighed og god service – både over for vores kunder og hinanden.

Toma er landsdækkende i Danmark, og vi har 750 dygtige medarbejdere.

Vi stiller krav til kvalitet, bæredygtighed, uddannelse, og arbejder seriøst med miljø og arbejdsmiljø.

Vi er medlem af Servicenormen, er ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001 certificeret, samt har certifikat på Svanemærket rengøring. 

Vi investerer i vores medarbejdere både socialt og udviklingsmæssigt, og tilbyder spændende karrieremuligheder for de rette kandidater.

Vi lever for vores serviceløfte om at skabe gode service-oplevelser og give folk en bedre arbejdsdag.

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt
Ansøgningsfrist: 1. september

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter gerne, så snart vi har fundet den rette.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV til mail: job@toma-as.dk – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

As you will be part of our service team, you will be responsible for providing engineering and expert services for our existing installations globally. - Able to work independently as well as part of a team.

- Fluent spoken and written Finnish and English skills

- A proven track record in designing critical communication networks and cyber security is seen as an advantage.

jobs.title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer (Data Center)
jobs.description:
**About us**

Established in 2006, Nordecon Oy is a multinational OEM company and solution provider specializing in complex end-to-end mobile, server, and custom-built desktop solutions. With nearly two decades of experience and a strong track record in delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions, the company is pivoting towards new opportunities. We are building a modern AI-focused Data Center in Finland designed for high-density GPU computing. Our infrastructure is being built from the ground up, giving you the opportunity to influence every aspect of the network architecture instead of maintaining legacy systems.

We are looking for an experienced Network & Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys designing, building and operating reliable infrastructure.

**What you will do**

You will be responsible for designing, implementing and operating the entire network infrastructure of the data center.

This role combines architecture, implementation and day-to-day technical ownership.

**Network Architecture**

- Design the complete data center network from the ground up.

- Develop scalable and resilient network architecture.

- Design physical fibre topology.

- Design IP addressing strategy.

- Design VLAN and VRF structure.

- Design rack connectivity standards.

- Produce and maintain network documentation.

- Plan future expansion of the infrastructure.


**External Connectivity**

- Design and maintain multi-ISP connectivity.

- Configure and operate BGP.

- Design Internet redundancy and failover.

- Coordinate network connectivity with providers.

- Plan future interconnection between multiple data center locations.


**Internal Network**

- Deploy and maintain switches, routers and firewalls.

- Configure Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking.

- Build management and out-of-band networks.

- Maintain network security.

- Troubleshoot complex networking issues.

- Support high-speed Ethernet environments (25G / 100G / 400G).


**Monitoring & Automation**

- Build network monitoring and alerting.

- Integrate infrastructure into monitoring platforms.

- Automate repetitive operational tasks.

- Maintain accurate documentation.

- Improve operational reliability.


**Infrastructure Integration**

Work closely with electrical and mechanical contractors to integrate infrastructure into a unified monitoring platform.

Examples include:

- UPS

- Generators

- Cooling systems

- Water pumps

- Fire detection systems

- Environmental monitoring

- Building Management System (BMS)


Experience with Modbus, BACnet or similar industrial protocols is an advantage but **not required**.

**Required Skills**

- Strong networking knowledge.

- Experience designing and deploying enterprise or data center networks.

- Cisco, Juniper, Arista or similar platforms.

- TCP/IP.

- BGP.

- OSPF.

- VLAN.

- LACP.

- Linux administration.

- Fibre networking.

- Excellent troubleshooting skills.

- Good documentation practices.

- Ability to independently deliver technical projects.


**Nice to Have**

- EVPN / VXLAN.

- Spine-Leaf architectures.

- Network automation.

- Python.

- Ansible.

- Grafana.

- Prometheus.

- Zabbix.

- GPU cluster networking.

- AI/HPC infrastructure.

- Kubernetes.

- Docker.

- Modbus.

- BACnet.


**What we are looking for**

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building infrastructure rather than simply maintaining existing environments.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of technical decisions, designing solutions from scratch and implementing them yourself.

You don't need to know everything. We value strong networking fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.

**What we offer**

- Opportunity to build a modern AI Data Center from the ground up.

- Freedom to influence technical decisions.

- Modern infrastructure.

- High level of technical ownership.

- Long-term career growth.

- Competitive salary based on experience.


**Work Setup**

Location: Riihimäki, Finland (hybrid work possible but on-site presence required at times)

Type: Full-time, permanent

Compensation: Competitive and based on experience. Start: As soon as a suitable candidate is found but the start date is flexible.

**Interested?**

Send your CV, short introduction, and salary request to **applications@nordecon.fi**.

If you have questions, feel free to reach out, were happy to discuss the role in more detail.

**Please note:** Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to respond individually to each applicant. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:

Hitachi Energy is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Technical Project Manager at Grid Automation business in Vaasa or Helsinki, Finland. You will be working on domestic and global services that typically consist of SCADA/DMS and RTU deliveries to end customers. This is a role for someone who has good leadership and management skills as well as a strong can-do mindset. You will successfully secure that the team can plan, execute and complete the services to our customers globally.

We offer you the opportunity to develop your project management competence in various ways and the possibility to work with both domestic and global customers in the areas of utility, industry, transportation and infrastructure. In this position, you will have the opportunity to further your career to a senior position, or in sales or general management.

**How youll make an impact**

- Leading the project team with clear guidelines, tasks and milestones, while motivating and providing feedback.

- Managing all aspects of the project to agreed-upon customer requirements and ensuring all technical, safety, quality and financial targets are met.

- Participating in domestic and export service projects of various sizes as a technical engineer.

- Overseeing the development of project plan documents in relation to scope, budget, schedule, and risk management.

- Monitoring each stage of project implementation to ensure best practices in cost control, resource efficiency, risk management and health, safety and the environment.

- Supporting our end-customers with your technical expertise, leading to better user experience, higher customer satisfaction and long-term collaboration.

- Identifying, analyzing and addressing service project risks, with the regular sharing of lessons learned.

- Providing technical support for our sales teams in designing the scope to be offered.

- Coordinating contract negotiation and claims with customers, in collaboration with the Supply Chain and Legal functions.

- Achieving service project deliverables and compliance with contract requirements. Building strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.


**Your background**

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.

- Project Management certification is considered as a benefit.

- Experience in SAP, MS Office and MS Project.

- Good communication skills in Finnish and in English.

- Willingness to work in a flexible project team.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Carpenter Co. is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams, serving a diverse global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide. Our Kouvola facility produces traditional comfort solutions, mattresses (both consumer & medical) and technical foams including rolls and bonded foam applications.

We are looking for an Account Manager to join our Finnish team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing sales and strengthening Carpenter's market position in Finland. You will work closely with existing customers while actively identifying new business opportunities within the manufacturing industry. This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of your customer portfolio, influence commercial strategy, and contribute directly to business growth in a global market-leading company.

What you'll do

- Drive the commercial growth of Carpenter Comfort Solutions in Finland.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and key stakeholders.

- Identify, pursue, and convert new business opportunities and market segments.

- Develop and execute sales plans aligned with business objectives.

- Monitor market developments, customer needs, and industry trends.

- Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, contracts, and business terms.

- Support profitability by managing pricing strategies and commercial risks.

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer experience and business performance.

What we're looking for

- At least 5 years of experience selling materials, components, or technical solutions to manufacturing industry customers.

- Experience managing and developing your own customer portfolio.

- A proven track record in acquiring new customers and growing sales.

- Strong commercial acumen and experience negotiating pricing and contracts.

- Experience developing and implementing sales strategies and business plans.

- The ability to identify market trends and translate them into commercial opportunities.

- Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in technical sales.

- Experience in polyurethane, furniture or bedding industry.

- Experience managing distributors, dealers, or key accounts in the Nordic market.

- A background in B2B sales and business development.

Location & Travel

This role requires regular travel within Finland to meet customers, develop business opportunities, and support market growth. Our Finnish team is based in Kouvola, and monthly visits to the office are expected.

Apply Now

To ensure a consistent recruitment process, all applications and CVs must be submitted in English through our recruitment system via [this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/account-manager/ZlEGpp) no later than 7 September 2026. We review and interview candidates throughout the application period, and the position may be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

jobs.title: YHTEISÖVALMENTAJAN SIJAINEN AMMATILLISEEN KOULUTUKSEEN
jobs.description:
Perho Liiketalousopisto on koulutusalojemme työnantajien perustama ammatillinen oppilaitos. Toimimme Helsingissä kolmella hyvin saavutettavalla kampuksella: Malmilla, Töölössä ja Urhea-kampuksella (Mäkelänrinteessä). Perhossa opiskellaan palvelualojen bisnestä, ja meiltä valmistuu taitavia ammattilaisia ravintola-, matkailu- ja luontoalan sekä liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin. Olemme myös urheiluoppilaitos ja tuemme tavoitteellisen urheilun ja opiskelun sujuvaa yhdistämistä. Monipuolisia oppimisympäristöjämme täydentävät mm. digikampuksemme sekä Perhon ravintolat, Green City Farm -kaupunkipelto, Perhon Panimo ja Juustola sekä Helmi Center -liikuntakeskus (www.perho.fi [http://www.perho.fi])

Perho kantaa pitkälle – se on lupauksemme perholaisille opiskelijoille ja työyhteisömme jäsenille! Perhon työyhteisössä on aikaansaava yhdessä tekemisen meininki. Työyhteisömme rakentuu eri alojen asiantuntijoista, jotka kannustavat toisiaan ja joiden kaikkien ääntä kuunnellaan. Perholaiset onnistuvat yhdessä!

Vakinaisen yhteisövalmentajamme toimivapaan myötä haemme nyt yhteisövalmentajan sijaista määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 21.9.-18.12.2026 väliselle ajalle.

Pääset työskentelemään Malmin ja Töölön kampuksillamme Perhon perustutkinto-opiskelijoiden parissa monipuolisissa toimintaympäristöissä. Päätehtävänäsi on aktivoida opiskelijoita liikkumaan, pelaamaan ja viettämään yhteistä aikaa oppituntien ulkopuolella sekä tutustuttamaan heitä yhteisöllisiin tiloihimme ja mahdollisuuksiin kampusympäristöissämme. Opiskelijoita aktivoivat ja ryhmähenkeä lisäävät tapahtumat ovat myös yhteisövalmentajan työpöydällä.

Opiskelijoiden lisäksi pääset työskentelemään tiiviisti opetushenkilöstön ja opiskeluhuoltoryhmän kanssa aktiivisen ja liikkuvan arjen edistämisessä sekä opiskelijoiden hyvinvoinnin tukemisessa.

Me odotamme sinulta

* tehtävään soveltuvaa tutkintoa - esimerkiksi yhteisöpedagogi, sosionomi tai kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perus- tai ammattitutkinto

* kokemusta nuorten kohtaamisesta ja työskentelystä heidän kanssaan

* hyvää yhteistyökykyä ja kokemusta ryhmätoiminnasta

* hyviä suullisia vuorovaikutusvalmiuksia

* aktiivista ja liikunnallista asennetta

* oma-aloitteista, itsenäistä ja innostavaa työotetta, valmiutta ja halua sitoutua perholaisiin arvoihin: rohkea, vastuullinen, palveleva ja innostava. Monikulttuurinen osaaminen katsotaan hakijalle eduksi.

Me tarjoamme sinulle

* monipuolisen ja haastavan tehtävänkuvan

* viihtyisän ja hyvinvointia edistävän työympäristön

* mahdollisuuden omaan ammatilliseen kehittymiseen

* Perho Liiketalousopiston ammatillisen koulutuksen kokemuksen ja edelläkävijyyden.

Palkka ja työsuhteen muut ehdot määräytyvät yksityistä opetusalaa koskevan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja siihen vaikuttavat valittavan hakijan tutkinto- ja osaamistausta sekä aikaisempi työkokemus. Työehtosopimuksen mukainen työaika on 36 h 15 min. / vko.

Työskentelemme alaikäisten parissa, joten tehtävään valitun tulee esittää itseään koskeva lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Kiinnostuitko yhteisövalmentajan tehtävästä? Hakuaika on avoinna perjantaihin 4.9. klo 12.00 asti ja haussa otetaan huomioon kaikki Perho Liiketalousopiston sähköisessä työnhakujärjestelmässä (https://toihin.perho.fi [https://toihin.perho.fi]) hakuaikana jätetyt hakemukset. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä voidaan täyttää heti sopivan hakijan löytyessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa opiskelijatuen ja ohjauksen tiimi- ja kehittämisvastaava Mari Biström 050 - 431 6687 ja mari.bistrom@perho.fi [mari.bistrom@perho.fi].

jobs.title: Emission Measurement Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Emission Measurement Engineer to strengthen the Emissions & Automation team in ourTesting & Validation Test Services. The location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, and the work is carried out at the Sustainable Technology Hub (STH) in Vaskiluoto.

Your role and responsibilities

We operate in the STH Plant, close to the test cells in the Hub and Research Lab. We strive to continuously improve our measurement methods and maintain our equipment in top condition. Youll be working as part of a dedicated team with diverse expertise.

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Carry out emission measurements in STH on production engines, test engines, and single-cylinder research engines
* Be part of a team developing new methods for emission measurements and continue the ongoing work of automating recurring emission measurements
* Develop your knowledge and expertise in the emission measurement area in the longer term, to also cover fuel gas analysis, measurement of particulates, and/or other more advanced methods
* Perform maintenance and calibration of the emission measurement equipment



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Relevant technical education (BSc or MSc, or equivalent, in Chemical, Environmental, Automation, or Electrical Engineering)
* Good understanding of technology and product development – knowledge of the Wärtsilä engine product family, systems, and solutions is seen as a benefit
* Strong internal motivation, passion for execution, and drive to get things completed
* Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

jobs.title: Solutions Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

Weâre building an AI scientist for our customers. We canât do that if we havenât built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. Solutions Delivery Manager works cross-functionally with Benchling's build organization, as well as across the CX departments, to develop robust solutions that can deliver value to our customers, while improving internal knowledge and productivity.

Chemistry is one of Benchling's newest and most exciting product areas â unlocking an entirely new group of companies, scientists, and science to be done on Benchling. This role will help navigate a budding product area through to market adoption, partnering closely with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and help shape our vision in this space.

Successful Solutions Delivery Managers will harness the knowledge and experience Benchling has gained across thousands of customer engagements, and leverage previous and learned experience to serve as an expert across scientific domains and modalities served by Benchling. They will develop, and continuously improve our solutions as both the science and Benchling product capabilities evolve. A successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams and systems, often with no existing guidance or playbook, to deliver impactful solutions and value aligned with our department and team goals.

Â

Including, but not limited to:

  • Navigate a budding product area through to market adoption â partnering with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and shape our vision in this space

  • Serve as a key advisor on customer accounts as an expert in the scientific and product space

  • Deliver services and oversee services engagements to ensure high quality solution and delivery

  • Build a roadmap of solution assets to deliver impactful solutions to the broader CX organization

  • Build and maintain solution assets, such as best practices documents

  • Train and educate the broader CX organization through various means (e.g. create documentation, drive enablement initiatives, refresh solutions, advise on customer engagements, etc.)

  • Collaborate across CX departments to reflect customer learnings into solution assets

Â 

QUALIFICATIONS
