jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Molecular Immunology
jobs.description:
About the position

Applications are invited for a 3 year position in a Research Fellowship as PhD candidate in molecular immunology to be based at the Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo, Norway. The research fellow must take part in the Faculty of Medicine's approved PhD program and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree.


More about the position

The fellowship period is 3 years and devoted to carrying out a project on the topic: “Modulation of adaptive immunity: Molecular drivers of T cell exhaustion”.

The work will consist of experiments to explore how cytosolic adapter molecules, particularly the adapter molecule SH2D2A, regulate resting as well as activated and experienced T cells, and how this relates to T cell exhaustion. The candidate will explore how cytosolic adapters modulate the phosphoproteome of T cells, using high end mass spectrometry approaches, as well as immunological and genetic techniques. 

The research fellow must take part in the faculty’s approved PhD program and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see: Why choose this PhD programme? - Faculty of Medicine

The applicant must, in collaboration with their supervisor, within 3 months after employment, have worked out a complete project description to be attached to the application for admission to the doctoral program. 

For more information, please see our website https://www.med.uio.no/english/research/phd/index.html

Starting date: as soon as possible.


Qualifications

The Faculty of Medicine has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this and will be expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in experimental life sciences (e.g. biology, chemistry, medicine) or similar subjects
  • Relevant, hands-on experience with mass spectrometry techniques, as well as immunological research.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Competence in immunologically relevant techniques such as flow cytometry, isolation of T-cells, assays for analysing T cell activation, immunoprecipitation and immunoblotting. 
  • Experience with gene technology methods such as PCR, DNA isolation, gene cloning, sequence analysis, mutagenesis.
  • Experience with proteomics techniques such as mass spectrometry, production of recombinant proteins.
  • Experience with work with experimental animals (mice), including FELASA C approval.
     

Language requirments

Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements: 
How to apply for admission to the PhD programme - Faculty of Medicine
 

Grade requirements
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

All candidates will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


Personal skills
  • Strong motivation
  • Good problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as an integrated member of a team
  • Good communication skills

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Professionally stimulating working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 to 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications). It is a requirement that the first paragraph of the CV contains confirmation that the candidate has the required qualifications specified for the position. 
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)
  • Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.
  • When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.


General information

When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the applicant’s academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to postdoctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

jobs.title: Customer Service Agent, Turku tai Kuhmo
jobs.description:
**Oletko asiakaspalvelun moniosaaja – tai haluatko kasvaa sellaiseksi?**

Tykkäätkö ratkaista ongelmia, kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä ja siitä fiiliksestä, kun asiakkaan asia tulee kerralla kuntoon?

**Saatat olla juuri se tyyppi, jota etsimme DialOk:lle Turkuun tai Kuhmoon!**

Haemme nyt uusia tekijöitä monipuolisiin asiakaspalvelutehtäviin. Tarjolla on **osa-aikaista työtä** (60-120h/kk).

**Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?**

DialOk:lla yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen. Tuotamme monikanavaista asiakaspalvelua useille suomalaisille yrityksille ja julkisen sektorin toimijoille, joten pääset työskentelemään erilaisten asiakkaiden ja tilanteiden parissa.

Palvelet asiakkaita **puhelimitse, sähköpostitse ja chatissa**. Tehtäviisi voi asiakkuudesta riippuen kuulua esimerkiksi:

- tilausten ja muiden yhteydenottojen hoitamista

- ajanvarausta

- asiakkaiden neuvontaa ja ongelmien ratkaisemista

- vaihteenhoitoa

- erilaisia back office -tehtäviä.


Työ ei sisällä puhelinmyyntiä.

Meillä onnistumista ei mitata sillä, kuinka nopeasti saat asiakkaan pois linjoilta, vaan sillä, että hänen asiansa tulee hoidettua **ammattimaisesti, ystävällisesti ja mahdollisimman sujuvasti**. Tavoitteemme on yksinkertainen: ensiluokkainen palvelukokemus – kanavasta riippumatta.

**Missä ja milloin töitä tehdään?**

Voit työskennellä viihtyisällä toimistollamme **Turussa tai Kuhmossa**. Kun talo, työtehtävät ja toimintatapamme ovat tulleet tutuiksi, tarjoamme mahdollisuuden myös osittaiseen **etätyöhön** perehdytyksen jälkeen.

Työajat sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin **klo 7–18**, mutta vuoroja on tarjolla myös iltaisin, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Osa-aikaisilta työntekijöiltä toivomme mahdollisuutta sitoutua vähintään **kahteen työvuoroon viikossa**.

**Millainen tyyppi pärjää meillä?**

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis asiakaspalvelun supersankari ensimmäisenä työpäivänä. Tärkeämpää meille on oikea asenne, halu oppia ja aito kiinnostus ihmisten auttamiseen.

Toivomme sinulta:

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, ruotsin kielen taito on etu

- positiivista ja palveluhenkistä asennetta

- kykyä pitää pää kylmänä myös kiireessä

- selkeää, rauhallista ja ystävällistä puhetyyliä

- hyviä kirjallisia taitoja

- sujuvia tietoteknisiä perustaitoja

- huolellista ja aikaansaavaa työotetta.


**Jos nautit ongelmien ratkaisemisesta, opit nopeasti uusia asioita ja saat energiaa onnistuneista asiakaskohtaamisista, olet jo pitkällä.**

**Mitä saat meiltä?**

- Tuntipohjaisen palkan (11,73 €) ja kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän

- joustavia työaikajärjestelyjä

- ajanmukaiset työvälineet

- osaavan ja energisen tiimin tuen

- Epassin liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut

- arvokasta kokemusta monikanavaisesta asiakaspalvelusta

- mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi useiden erilaisten asiakkuuksien parissa

- mahdollisuuden osittaiseen etätyöhön perehdytyksen jälkeen. Täysin etänä työtä ei voi tehdä.


Ja ennen kaikkea ympärillesi porukan, jonka kanssa töitä tehdään **ammattimaisesti mutta hyvällä fiiliksellä**.

**Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa – laita hakemus tulemaan!**

Kerro meille, kuka olet, miksi asiakaspalvelu kiinnostaa sinua ja miksi juuri sinä sopisit DialOk:lle.

jobs.title: Expert Observabilité - Dynatrace GEN3 (H/F)
jobs.description:
Nous recrutons pour le compte de notre client, un(e) Expert(e) Observabilité pour renforcer une équipe dédiée à l'ingénierie et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles d'une plateforme d'observabilité SaaS, dans le cadre d'une mission de 6 mois renouvelable.

VOS MISSIONS

Spécialisation logs
     - Intégration structurée des logs dans la plateforme : collecte, indexation, exploitation et optimisation des flux
     - Mise en place de mécanismes de corrélation avancée entre logs, traces et métriques pour une vision bout-en-bout
     - Définition et application de règles de gouvernance : standardisation des formats, politiques de rétention, classification des données, gestion des droits d'accès (RBAC)

Observabilité
     - Contribution active aux projets techniques liés à la plateforme, de la conception au déploiement et à l'exploitation
     - Intégration dans des environnements cloud hybrides (on-premise + cloud public : AWS, Azure, GCP)
     - Amélioration continue du cycle de vie de la plateforme selon une approche Observability as Code (intégration des SLO dans les pipelines CI/CD, automatisation des configurations)

Collaboration & Support
     - Accompagnement des équipes DevSecOps dans l'onboarding des applications et des usages
     - Conseil technique et support aux équipes internes pour optimiser l'utilisation de la plateforme
     - Participation à la communauté interne : partage de bonnes pratiques, formation, contribution aux initiatives transverses

PROFIL RECHERCHE
     - Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en observabilité, avec une spécialisation avérée sur les logs
     - Maîtrise complète de l'intégration et de l'exploitation des logs dans un environnement SaaS
     - Expertise Dynatrace GEN3 (architecture, déploiement, configuration, exploitation), avec expérience concrète de migration GEN2 vers GEN3 (critère indispensable)
     - Corrélation avancée entre logs, traces et métriques (Davis AI, PurePath, Log Monitoring ou équivalents)
     - Expérience approfondie en collecte de logs (Fluentd, OpenTelemetry Collector), indexation (ELK, Loki) et gouvernance des données
     - Connaissance des environnements cloud hybrides (AWS, Azure, GCP)
     - Compréhension des sources de logs dans Kubernetes/OpenShift (pods, conteneurs, nodes)
     - Infrastructure as Code : Ansible, Terraform
     - Développement/scripting : Python, Bash ou Go (automatisation, scripts d'intégration)
     - Pratique de l'Observability as Code (outils CLI dédiés, Terraform Provider Dynatrace ou équivalent)

Atouts appréciés
     - OpenTelemetry (collecte unifiée des données)
     - Splunk ou ELK
     - CI/CD : Jenkins, GitLab CI
     - Sensibilité sécurité et collaboration avec des équipes SOC (détection d'anomalies, bonnes pratiques de logging sécurisé)

Environnement technique : Dynatrace, Splunk, ELK, Loki, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, Fluentd, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, Linux, Windows, Apache, Wildfly, J2EE

jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Avec plus d'un million de sièges équipant les flottes des plus grandes compagnies aériennes, Safran Seats est l'un des leaders mondiaux des sièges pour passagers, équipages d'avions et hélicoptères grâce à des solutions innovantes et à forte valeur ajoutée.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.

Descriptif missionPosition Summary:

The Machining Process Engineer is responsible for developing, industrializing, and continuously improving machining processes to support safe, efficient, and high quality production.

The role contributes to cost reduction, productivity improvement, and operator capability development through robust process design and technical expertise.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Process & Industrialization

o Lead the industrialization of new parts in coordination with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality teams.

o CNC programs (CATIA)

o Fixtures and tooling solutions

o Tooling lists and setup instructions

o Process documentation and work instructions

o Perform process simulation, verification, and prove out prior to serial production.

2. Production Support & Continuous Improvement

o Provide technical support to production cells for quality and efficiency issues (QRQC, 8D).

o Analyze root causes of process non conformities and implement corrective actions.

o Propose and implement improvement actions to:

o Reduce machining cycle time

o Reduce consumables and non value added time

o Improve overall equipment efficiency

o Work closely with cell leaders to achieve cell KPIs.

3. Cost & Performance

o Contribute to production cost reduction through optimized machining strategies and tooling selection.

o Participate in capacity, investment, and equipment specification activities (tools, fixtures, gauges).

4. Training & Knowledge Transfer

o Create machining and process training materials.

o Train production operators to strengthen technical skills and process understanding.

5. Collaboration

o Work effectively with cross functional departments and support a collaborative working culture.

o Share best practices and lessons learned within the organization.

Position Summary...The General Merchandise Department Manager at Walmart plays a key leadership role in delivering a great customer experience by keeping the sales floor stocked, organized, and ready for business. This role leads and supports associates in completing handheld tasks, maintaining merchandise standards, and assisting customers with their shopping needs. By actively planning and prioritizing work based on workload and customer traffic, the Department Manager drives strong execution, teamwork, and resultsâwhile ensuring a safe, clean, and high energy store environment.

What You'll Do...

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Deliver An Excellent Customer Experience

Provides friendly and professional customer service by greeting customers, assisting with product selection, promoting products and services, helping locate merchandise, supporting purchase decisions, and resolving concerns or referring them as appropriate.

Execute Daily Merchandising and Availability Tasks

Delegates, supports, and follows up on the completion of Customer Availability Process tasks, including section work, capping bins, and stocking picks.

Price Changes, Features, and Modular Execution

Delegates, supports, and follows up on the completion of price changes, feature sets, and modulars within assigned areas to maintain merchandise accuracy and presentation standards.

Sales Floor Coverage and Recovery

Assigns associates to support coverage as needed across the sales floor and provides support with recovery and zoning activities to keep the store customer-ready.

Associate Scheduling and Break Coverage

Ensures associate breaks are taken in accordance with coverage requirements to support smooth operations.

Associate Training and Coaching

Provides training, coaching, and ongoing feedback to associates to support performance, development, and engagement.

Safety, Cleanliness, and Compliance

Maintains a safe, clean, and hazard-free work environment by following Company policies and procedures, completing safety sweep logs, and ensuring displays and fixtures are secure and free of debris.

Flexibility (Availability/Work Schedule)

  • Be open to working a variety of shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on business needs. Your adaptability helps ensure the store runs smoothly and customers receive consistent, high-quality service.

POTENTIAL CHALLENGES IN THIS ROLE

High Task Volume in a Fast-Paced Environment

  • Manages overnight hours effectively and planning accordingly to stay energized and focused.
  • Effectively manages work hours and plans ahead to maintain energy and focus throughout the shift.
  • Handles a fast-paced workload with efficiency, ensuring large volumes of restocking and recovery are completed accurately and on time.

Physical Demands

  • Performs physical tasks such as standing for extended periods, bending, and lifting inventory, equipment, or supplies weighing up to 20 lbs., and occasionally up to 50 lbs.
  • Performs repetitive tasks such as stocking, zoning, and organizing products with attention to detail and consistency to uphold store standards.

WHY YOU'LL ENJOY WORKING HERE

Energetic, Fast-Paced Environment

Thrive in a dynamic setting where every day brings something new.

Appreciation for Your Efforts

Your contributions are recognized and valued.

Career Growth Opportunities

Build your skills and advance your career with us.

Meaningful Impact

Take pride in helping customers save money and live better.

The minimum rate of pay for this position starts from $19.35.

jobs.title: PRACOWNIK SOCJALNY
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: 1) praca socjalna;
2) przeprowadzanie rodzinnych wywiadów środowiskowych;
3) dokonywanie analizy, diagnozy i oceny zjawisk indywidualnych i społecznych, a także formułowanie opinii w zakresie zapotrzebowania na świadczenia z pomocy społecznej oraz kwalifikowanie do uzyskania tych świadczeń;
4) pomoc w uzyskaniu dla osób lub rodzin będących w trudnej sytuacji życiowej specjalistycznego poradnictwa, terapii lub innych form pomocy w zakresie możliwości rozwiązywania problemów przez właściwe instytucje państwowe, samorządowe i organizacje pozarządowe;
5) udzielanie pomocy zgodnie z zasadami etyki zawodowej;
6) pobudzanie społecznej aktywności i inspirowanie działań samopomocowych w zaspokajaniu niezbędnych potrzeb życiowych osób, rodzin, grup i środowisk społecznych;
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- umiejętności: doświadczenie w pracy w zespole - konieczne; obsługa komputera - pakiet programów office - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wymagania konieczne:
1) posiadanie obywatelstwa polskiego;
2) pełna zdolność do czynności prawnych oraz korzystanie z pełni praw publicznych;
3) posiadanie kwalifikacji do wykonywania zawodu pracownika socjalnego zgodnie z art. 116 ustawy o pomocy społecznej.
Wymagania dodatkowe:
1) znajomość przepisów dotyczących w szczególności pomocy społecznej, realizowania usług społecznych przez centrum usług społecznych, wspierania rodziny i systemu pieczy zastępczej, przeciwdziałania przemocy domowej, ochrony zdrowia psychicznego, świadczeń opieki zdrowotnej finansowanych ze środków publicznych, ochrony danych osobowych oraz innych przepisów związanych z realizacją zadań CUS;
2) umiejętność obsługi komputera;
3) prawo jazdy kat. B oraz gotowość do wykorzystania samochodu prywatnego do celów służbowych zgodnie z obowiązującymi przepisami;
4) umiejętność diagnozowania sytuacji osób i rodzin oraz planowania działań pomocowych;
5) umiejętność nawiązywania kontaktu i współpracy z osobami i rodzinami znajdującymi się w trudnej sytuacji

jobs.title: Executive Social Media Specialist (Contract)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Office of the CEO works directly with Amjad Masad and CEO leadership to advance Replit's strategy, external presence, and long-term positioning. This role sits at the intersection of the Office of the CEO and Replit's Brand and Creative function, with a singular focus: building personal presence into one of the defining founder voices of the AI era.

The Executive Social Media Specialist will build an intentional, premium, long-term strategy across visual channels, primarily Instagram. This is an all-in-one creative operator role, not a traditional social media manager. You will travel and capture meaningful moments as they happen, edit quickly, and publish polished content without relying on a larger production team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own photography, videography, editing, and publishing across official social channels

 - Travel with the CEO to capture speaking engagements, interviews, awards, office visits, and meaningful meetings as they happen

 - Identify and produce content around the pillars that have proven to resonate: founder story and personal journey, entrepreneurship and company building, global perspective and cultural identity, and human founder moments

 - Develop premium, documentary-style storytelling that favors real moments over manufactured content

 - Build out a presence on Instagram and other visual mediums through premium photography, documentary-style video, and behind-the-scenes storytelling

 - Maintain quality and brand guardrails, prioritizing credibility and long-term influence over trend-chasing, gimmicks, or a high-volume creator posting cadence

 - Partner closely with Replit's Marketing and Communications teams while remaining focused on distinct personal brand

 - Move from concept to final execution independently, with strong creative judgment and a fast turnaround




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Proven experience producing premium photography and video content for an executive, founder, public figure, or creator, ideally including hands-on shooting and editing

 - A portfolio demonstrating documentary-style storytelling, not just short-form trend content

 - Comfort and flexibility with travel, as the role involves capturing real-world moments and appearances

 - Strong judgment on tone and positioning, able to distinguish content that builds long-term credibility from content that chases short-term engagement

 - Ability to work independently across the full production cycle: capture, edit, and publish

 - Familiarity with platform-specific storytelling across Instagram and other visual, photo- and video-first mediums

 - Discretion and professionalism given close proximity to executive and personal moments

 - Experience building a personal or executive brand from an early stage is a strong plus




CONTRACT ENGAGEMENT INCLUDES

 - Competitive contract rate, with compensation

 - Direct, high-visibility partnership with Replit's CEO and Office of the CEO

 - Autonomous work environment with fast decision-making and minimal bureaucracy



This is a contract role and does not offer full time benefits.

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character. Interdisciplinarity in research and teaching is key to the University's approach to addressing tomorrow's societal challenges. Embedded in Luxembourg's diverse and multicultural society, the University offers a welcoming, multilingual environment where students and researchers from around the world feel at home. Its human size fosters close interaction between students and lecturers, creating a personal atmosphere. With 1,600 members of academic staff for 6,700+ students and 1,000+ Ph.D. candidates, students feel connected and valued on their academic journey. Internationally recognised research drives innovation in digital transformation, health, and sustainable development. This scientific progress is supported by cutting-edge infrastructure and a national commitment to education, research, and innovation. The dynamics of a young university offer rare potential and scope for exploring new ideas.

The Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) is part of the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg. DHML coordinates all teaching programmes in medicine, life sciences, nursing, radiography and midwifery. Research at the department integrates basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches with a focus on cancer biology, as well as clinical research projects on human health and disease. Related research within the University encompasses clinical psychology and cognitive sciences at the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) and research on neurological disorders and dementia at the Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB).

The DHML cooperates with national health care centres and with leading international biomedical research institutions. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing its training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical, biomedical and mental health initiatives.

Your role

As part of the University's expansion of its medical and health sciences portfolio, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences seeks to appoint a Professor in Psychiatry. The successful candidate will establish and lead the medical specialisation programme (Diplômes d'Études Spécialisées – DES) in psychiatry, contribute to ongoing initiatives for mental health support and develop a strong line of research in a related field.

The position combines innovative postgraduate teaching in psychiatry with the development of an interdisciplinary research programme, supported by state-of-the-art infrastructure and excellent possibilities for collaborative work, particularly in neurosciences, clinical psychology and cognitive sciences.

The professorship represents a rare opportunity to shape the further development of medical education and research at the University of Luxembourg in close cooperation with colleagues across the University as well as with local and international hospitals.

The successful candidate will:

• Design, develop and implement a modern, state-of-the-art psychiatry curriculum
• Lead the medical specialisation programme in psychiatry and coordinate psychiatry-related teaching activities within the University's study programmes in medicine and other health-related sciences
• Collaborate with faculty colleagues and clinical partners to ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students
• Implement innovative educational approaches and digital learning resources to provide students with comprehensive and engaging learning opportunities
• Establish research activities in psychiatry or related disciplines
• Integrate into ongoing research endeavours in mental health, e.g. Department of Behavioural and Cognitive Sciences, and/or neurosciences, e.g. Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine
• Supervise Master students and PhD candidates
• Contribute to translational efforts in advancing mental health care, e.g. early detection, prevention, innovative treatments, integration of digital solutions
• Engage in clinical psychiatry in Luxembourg

For further information about the role, please contact: Professor Serge Haan, Head of the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences,

Email: Serge.Haan@uni.lu

Your profile

• Relevant clinical qualification in psychiatry and significant clinical experience; at least 5 years of practice
• Robust experience in teaching psychiatry at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level
• Authorization or eligibility to apply for authorization to practice as a psychiatrist in Luxembourg
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching
• Experience in designing and implementing new educational programmes or courses at university level
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, including online learning platforms and simulation-based training
• Strong track record in clinical and/or biomedical research in a relevant domain, with international recognition, a focus on therapeutic processes and/or aetiological research on mental disorders will be considered an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build and sustain academic and clinical partnerships, particularly with partner universities and healthcare institutions
• Visionary and transformational leadership skills, ability to thrive in a dynamic and pioneering academic environment

Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities

jobs.title: Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve. We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as a subsidary in the UK. Supervised by the CSSF we have the ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.

When you join us you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

The Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & MLRO has primary responsibility for implementation, oversight and monitoring of the Group's financial crime compliance framework (across money laundering & terrorist financing, sanctions, bribery & corruption, external fraud risks), ensuring robust risk management, full regulatory compliance, and effective detection and reporting of financial crime, thereby safeguarding the integrity, reputation, and resilience of the organisation. The role holder acts as the central point of contact with competent authorities and the FIU on financial crime (including specifically AML/CFT ) matters.

Key Accountabilities

Group AML/CFT Framework Leadership:

• Define, implement and maintain a consistent and effective Group-wide FCC framework aligned with applicable regulations and group risk appetite  across all entities.
• Ensure policies, procedures and control expectations are defined, implemented and maintained.    

Group Financial Crime Risk Stewardship:

• Oversee the effectiveness of the financial crime risk control framework .  
• Provide advice,  guidance and challenge to the 1LoD risk and control ownership.  
• Coordinate and maintain the group-wide financial crime risk assessment.

Client Due Diligence Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of client due diligence and client acceptance processes.
• Ensure higher risk clients are subject to enhanced due diligence.
• Monitor compliance with client onboarding and periodic review requirements.            
                        
Suspicious Activity Reporting Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of transaction monitoring and client/transaction screening arrangements including systems/toolings.
• Act as ultimate escalation point for suspicious activity, investigate complex cases and ensure timely and compliant reporting to FIUs.                                    

Regulatory Engagement & Representation:

• Serve as primary contact for regulators, leading inspections, managing regulatory interactions, overseeing regulatory reporting and ensuring remediation of findings for financial crime matters.                                    

Group MLRO Network & Local Oversight:

• Lead and coordinate local MLROs, ensuring consistent governance, escalation, independence and oversight across jurisdictions.
Governance, Board Reporting & Advisory:
• Provide regular FCC reporting to senior management and the Board, advising on risk exposure, control effectiveness and mitigation strategies.
• Ensure escalation of major financial crime risk events, breaches or control issues, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation and remediation.

Culture, Training & Awareness:

• Promote a strong compliance culture throughout the organisation by designing and delivering effective AML/CFT training and awareness across all levels of the organisation

Knowledge and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CFE) preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance within the financial services industry (Larger bank / big four preferred), with a focus on AML, ABC, sanctions, and policy framework.
• In-depth knowledge of European and UK regulatory requirements related to financial crime compliance, including AML directives, sanctions regimes, and bribery/corruption laws.                          
• Proven experience in developing and implementing FCC policies, procedures, and controls across multiple jurisdictions.
• Strong leadership and management skills with the ability to effectively oversee a team and drive results in a dynamic and complex environment.  

Attributes and Qualities

• Leadership & People Management                                
• Collaborative Teamwork                                
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                                
• Conflict Resolution & Negotiation

Technical Skills

• MS Office proficiency

Languages Skills

• English: Fluent
• Any other Quintet language is considered an asset

Job Description



ArcelorMittal Long Products Luxembourg recherche pour son équipe SUPPLY CHAIN : un(e) Gestionnaire flotte ferroviaire

Objectif du poste

Assurer le pilotage et l'optimisation de la flotte de wagons LPL afin de garantir la disponibilité des moyens nécessaires aux activités logistiques, d'optimiser la rotation des actifs ferroviaires et de contribuer à la performance globale de la chaîne logistique.

Le poste couvre l'ensemble des flux ferroviaires liés aux wagons chargés, wagons vides, wagons de demi-produits et wagons de mitrailles.



Responsabilités

Gestion et optimisation de la flotte

• Réaliser la revue annuelle du dimensionnement de la flotte en fonction des besoins budgétés.
• Analyser les performances de la flotte et proposer les ajustements nécessaires afin d'optimiser son utilisation et les coûts associés.
• Assurer le suivi quotidien de la position, de la disponibilité, de l'état et de la rotation des wagons.



Coordination opérationnelle

• Garantir la disponibilité des wagons nécessaires au programme de transport.
• Identifier et traiter les anomalies impactant les flux ferroviaires (retards, rétention client, avaries, restrictions d'infrastructure, déséquilibres de flotte, etc.).
• Coordonner les opérations de repositionnement, parkage, déparkage et remise en exploitation des wagons.
• Orienter les actions nécessaires avec les transporteurs ferroviaires, les sites de production, les Order Managers et les équipes de planification.



Reporting et amélioration continue

Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance, produire les reportings nécessaires et proposer les actions d'amélioration adaptées.

Principaux KPI :

    Nombre de wagons vides disponibles au Luxembourg.
    Nombre de wagons en maintenance, révision ou réparation.
    Rotation des wagons par axe et par type de flux.
    Nombre de trains annulés ou impactés pour manque de charge ou de wagons.
    Taux de remplissage des trains.
    Temps moyen d'immobilisation des wagons.

Polyvalence

Assurer le remplacement du coordinateur approvisionnement mitraille et participer à toute activité contribuant au bon fonctionnement des opérations ferroviaires et logistiques quand nécessaire. (SOP équilibrage des flux)



Compétences requises

• Maîtrise de SAP et Excel.
• Bonne compréhension des flux industriels, logistiques et ferroviaires.
• Capacité d'analyse, d'organisation et de résolution de problèmes.
• Rigueur, autonomie et réactivité.
• Bonnes capacités de communication et de coordination.
• Anglais professionnel.

jobs.title: HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten lokalisiert sein:

- Amadora, Portugal- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechische Republik- Warschau, Polen

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des HR-internen Kontrollsystems.- Sie koordinieren und übernehmen Aktivitäten im Bereich Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) für HR-relevante Prozesse.- Sie entwickeln, dokumentieren und optimieren Kontrolldesigns zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer und interner Compliance-Anforderungen.- Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit etablierter Kontrollen, analysieren Kontrollschwächen und treiben geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen nach.- Sie wirken bei der Durchführung von Control-Monitoring-Aktivitäten mit und bereiten Nachweise für interne und externe Audits auf.- Sie sind zuständig für Überwachung von Cybersecurity Controls innerhalb der HR-Funktion und arbeiten eng mit Cybersecurity-, IT- und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen.- Sie beraten Prozessverantwortliche hinsichtlich Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Anforderungen und fördern die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Kontrollen.- Sie erstellen Management-Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte und relevante Governance-Gremien.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risikomanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Compliance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management oder Governance.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS), ICFR-/SOX-nahen Anforderungen oder Audit-Prozessen.- Sie haben gute Kenntnisse von HR-Prozessen sowie deren Risiko- und Kontrollanforderungen sind von Vorteil.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.- Sie haben keinen Studienabschluss? Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Berufsausbildung in Verbindung mit einer qualifizierten Weiterbildung und darauf bezogene umfangreiche fachspezifische Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse, gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.- Sie können komplexe Compliance- und Kontrollanforderungen verständlich vermitteln.- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.- Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder ohne direkte Weisungskompetenz zu beeinflussen.- Sie bringen eine hohe Integrität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Risiko- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.- Sie treiben Veränderungen aktiv voran und fördern eine nachhaltige Compliance- und Kontrollkultur.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Klaus Kouril.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

jobs.title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.

Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.

Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).

Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.

At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.

Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
jobs.description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Purpose of the role  

  *  In this role, you contribute to the development of advanced technical solutions that improve assembly processes and ensure reliable end-of-line testing.
  *  Strong collaboration, structured problem-solving, and a high standard of technical quality are essential to support efficient and stable manufacturing operations.
  *  As an Automation Engineer in Industrial Engineering, you play a key role in designing, developing, maintaining, and standardizing technical solutions for assembly lines and end-of-line testing equipment.
  *  Your work directly supports the efficiency, quality, and reliability of manufacturing processes across global sites.


Responsibilities:

  *  Development of Assembly and End-of-Line Testing Equipment


  *  Execute the full development lifecycle for automated and system-controlled assembly and end-of-line testing equipment, with a focus on automation, as part of project teams.
  *  Design, build, validate, and release automation equipment and devices for production use in collaboration with VAT Group teams and external suppliers.
  *  Work with global cross-functional teams to collect user requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  *  Support global sites in the introduction of new end-of-line test processes, including the development and release of production and test equipment for new product introductions and new process requirements.
  *  Develop and implement technical solutions that meet industry standards and follow engineering best practices.


  *  Project Management and Documentation


  *  Prepare clear and accurate technical specification documents in line with applicable CE conformity requirements.

  *  Integrate electrical and electronic components into fully functional automation systems.

  *  Troubleshooting and Continuous Improvement


  *  Analyze, optimize, and upgrade existing automation solutions.
  *  Maintain technical documentation and ensure functional definitions remain up to date.
  *  Review user feedback and implement necessary improvements and updates.
  *  Provide third-level technical support to local sites when required.


Qualifications:  

  *  Experience with manufacturing equipment connectivity, including communication protocols and system architecture.
  *  Experience in the automation of production processes and end-of-line testing.
  *  Experience in the automation of assembly and end-of-line testing processes.
  *  Experience contributing to cross-functional projects in an industrial environment.
  *  A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electronics, automation, or a related field; a master’s degree is an advantage.

  *  Knowledge of engineering development processes and working methods.
  *  Good communication skills in English; German is an advantage.

jobs.title: Dispute and Chargebacks, Program Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Role Summary

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Disputes and Chargeback Program Manager at Replit, you’ll be part of our Trust and Safety Operations team, who owns customer-facing workflows that handle sensitive and policy-driven interactions across the Support organization. This includes areas such as privacy requests, DMCA and intellectual property claims, law enforcement requests, and abuse appeals.

You'll own Replit's disputes and chargeback function end-to-end: from the individual case in front of you to the policies, playbooks, and automation that let it hold up as we scale to millions of users. This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution: you'll determine dispute and chargeback strategy, and build the systems that make those decisions repeatable at scale, working closely with Engineering, Legal and Finance.

 

In this role you will…

 - Own the full dispute lifecycle: investigate incoming chargebacks and disputes, decide whether and how to represent, gather evidence, and respond within network deadlines.

 - Design and maintain the policies, decision trees, and SOPs that govern how disputes and chargebacks are handled.

 - Define the key metrics, health targets, and goals for the disputes program and track performance against them, reporting to leadership.

 - Monitor chargeback rates and dispute trends to identify the underlying drivers of volume, and partner with Engineering and Finance to address root causes.

 - Partner with Engineering and Support Operations to automate manual parts of the workflow (evidence gathering, decisioning logic, etc).

 - Build training, documentation, and escalation paths that enable frontline support teams to handle dispute-related inquiries confidently and consistently as the program scales.



Required Skills and Experience:

 - 6+ years of hands-on experience owning disputes/chargebacks operations, ideally where you built or significantly leveled up the function rather than just running an existing one.

 - Deep familiarity with major card network dispute rules and reason codes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including compelling-evidence frameworks and network monitoring/excessive-dispute programs (e.g., Visa's VDMP/VFMP, Mastercard's ECP)

 - Experience building or improving SOPs, playbooks, or workflows in a support or operations environment.

 - Experience partnering with Engineering to scope and prioritize automation, even if you're not writing the code yourself.

 - Comfort operating as both a hands-on operator and systems builder in a scaling environment.

 - Strong judgment and decision-making skills when handling sensitive or ambiguous customer situations.

 - Experience translating policy or legal requirements into clear, repeatable processes or customer-facing guidance.

 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, empathetically, and precisely in high-stakes situations.

 - Proven track record working cross-functionally to deliver impactful results.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Hands-on experience with Stripe's dispute tooling specifically, including submitting evidence and managing dispute workflows through Stripe.

 - Experience in customer support, trust & safety, support operations, or similar roles within a technology company.

 - Experience in a high-growth or usage-based SaaS environment, where dispute patterns and volume can shift quickly with product changes.

 - Familiarity with fraud detection tooling and how it intersects with the disputes function.

 - Experience managing outsourced or contract support as programs scale, in case this function grows beyond a single person down the line.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

These products already give people new ways to turn an idea into something they can see, share, and use. Your job is to help more people discover them, understand when to use them, and make them part of their regular workflow.

You’ll own the connection between the product and its audiences: developing positioning grounded in customer needs, leading launches, finding channels that can drive sustained adoption, tracking the competitive landscape, and bringing market feedback back to Product.

SEO Specialist

Work tasks: Company for Business OÜ is looking for an SEO specialist to develop and promote the company’s web projects. The specialist’s primary objective is to increase the organic visibility of the company’s websites in Google Search.
Key Responsibilities • Developing and implementing an SEO strategy for the company’s websites. • Promoting websites in Google for commercial and informational search queries. • Conducting technical SEO audits and monitoring the resolution of identified issues. • Analysing website structure, URLs, indexation, canonical tags, robots.txt, sitemaps and internal links. • Working with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Collecting and clustering the semantic core / keyword set. • Conducting keyword research and analysing search intent. • Analysing competitors and their SEO strategies. • Developing content plans together with editors and writers. • Preparing SEO briefs and technical specifications for new pages and articles. • Optimising existing content and landing pages. • Working with title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H3 headings, internal linking and page structure. • Monitoring the indexation and search visibility of newly published content. • Identifying opportunities to increase the websites’ topical authority. • Developing and implementing an off-page SEO and link-building strategy. • Analysing the backlink profiles of the company’s websites and competitors. • Monitoring rankings, organic traffic, CTR and conversions from organic search. • Preparing regular SEO reports.

We offer: • Flexible working arrangements (full-time or part-time).
• Remote work opportunities. • Long-term cooperation. • Competitive remuneration depending on experience and qualifications. • High salary.

Other requirements: Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a person who can work systematically with technical SEO, content, semantics, backlink profiles, analytics and search visibility. We are not looking for a specialist whose role is limited to placing keywords or purchasing links, but for a team member who wants to develop together with the company. The key result of the role is sustainable growth in high-quality organic traffic, rankings for commercially important queries and the company website’s overall search visibility. What We Expect from the Candidate • Practical SEO experience. • A strong understanding of how Google Search works. • Experience conducting technical SEO audits. • Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Ability to conduct keyword research and competitor research. • Understanding of on-page and off-page SEO. • Understanding of link-building principles. • Experience working with large content-driven websites will be an advantage. Tools Experience with some of the following tools is preferred: • Google Search Console; • Google Analytics; • Ahrefs / Semrush; • Screaming Frog; • Google Keyword Planner; • PageSpeed Insights.
