jobs.title: Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice
jobs.description:
Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Nørrebro)

Position: Full-Time (37 hours / week)

Salary: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Diamond Slice

At Diamond Slice, we bring proper New York slice shop culture to Copenhagen. We elevate the humble slice with high-hydration sourdough, top-tier seasonal local ingredients, natural wines, craft beers, and cocktails—all served in a fast-paced, high-energy, welcoming neighborhood environment.  We pride ourselves on exceptional quality, great hospitality, and an unpretentious vibe.

We are growing and looking for a driven Front of House Manager to lead our floor operations, nurture our team culture, and deliver outstanding guest experiences.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

As FOH Manager, you will take ownership of the day-to-day guest experience, lead shift execution, and serve as a key operational anchor for both our daily service and special events.

  • FOH Leadership & Experience: Take ownership of the Front of House, ensuring smooth service flow, excellent atmosphere, and high operational standards.

  • Team Coaching & Motivation: Train, mentor, and inspire the FOH team to build a high-performing, friendly, and efficient service squad.

  • Guest Communication: Serve as the primary face and voice for guest interactions, handling feedback, special requests, and inquiries with warmth and professionalism.

  • Festivals & Events Logistics: Play a central, hands-on role in planning and executing logistics for outdoor festivals, pop-ups, and special catering events.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced hospitality leader who takes initiative, and thrives with autonomy.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in hospitality (with proven leadership or supervisory experience preferred).

  • Autonomy & Problem Solving: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership to solve operational challenges independently.

  • Assertive Communication: Unafraid to speak up, bring issues to the table, and constructively challenge the status quo to make operations better.

  • Feedback Culture: Skilled and comfortable with both giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback with colleagues and leadership.

  • Guest-Centric Mindset: Genuinely loves host culture, high-energy environments, and personal interactions with guests.

  • Schedule Availability: Fully comfortable working evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month, aligned with your experience.

  • Flexible Schedule: High degree of scheduling flexibility, provided operations run smoothly and team coverage is secure.

  • Autonomous Role: Real freedom to shape FOH operations and make your mark on our growing brand.

  • Great Culture: A fast-paced, supportive, and passionate workplace with high standards and great pizza.

How to Apply

Ready to join the Diamond Slice team?

Please submit your CV along with a short introduction telling us about yourself and why you'd be a great fit for Diamond Slice to: work@diamondslice.dk

Note! Applications must include: "Diamond Slice FOH Manager" in the subject line to be considered.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Junior Embedded Software / Payload Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to work within sustainability and drones? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you. 

Our tech team is looking for a new colleague to help build and improve the electronics that turn our drones into precision measuring instruments. If you enjoy hands-on hardware work in a greentech environment and want real ownership over what you build, we want to hear from you. 

About the job 

You will be part of a small, talented tech team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our fleet of custom UAV deployed across the world to help map critical emissions. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Developing payload firmware that communicates with our drone systems (MAVLink / DJI) and onboard gas instrumentation and other sensors. 

  • Helping to bring new sensor instruments from datasheet to bench to flight. 

  • Improving and fixing existing payloads, diagnose issues on the bench and through in-flight data, harden the firmware, and ship the fix. 

  • Building small interface and breakout PCBs in KiCad, from assembly and bringing it up through to your own revisions. 

  • Potential for CAD and other mechanical work, depending on your qualifications. 

About you 

  • A bachelor's degree or similar/higher in electronics, robotics, computer engineering, mechatronics, physics or similar. 

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience, from your studies, a project, or a job. 

  • Tinker with Arduino/Raspberry Pi type projects. 

  • Wired up and used Serial/UART, I²C, SPI, etc., not just read about them. 

  • Basic C/C++ (or Arduino) and a bit of Python. 

  • English at a professional level. 

Nice to have 

  • Curiosity about drones, sensors and physical measurements. 

  • PCB design/KiCad experience, with signal/noise integrity knowledge. 

  • CAD and/or mechanical knowledge. 

  • Python for log analysis and quick tooling. 

  • Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement. 

What we offer 

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact. 

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance. 

  • Real hardware ownership early on, with a senior engineer to learn from. 

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early. 

  • A close-knit, supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning. 

  • Work that measurably cuts industrial emissions. 

About Explicit 

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish engineering company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industry sectors. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology. Every measurement depends on the payload the drone carries: the boards, firmware, and sensors. 

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. 

Practical information 

  • Application deadline: 21 August 2026 

  • Expected start date: 1 October 2026 or 1 November 2026 

  • Location: Virum, Denmark 

How to apply 

Please send your application, including a few lines about what you’ve built and your CV, to jobs@explicit.dk. 

If you have any questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Rune Brogaard, Technical Manager, at ryb@explicit.dk

jobs.title: Inside Sales Contractor
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:

Monday - Friday

Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:

We’re bringing frontier intelligence to the “Fortune 5 million,” across an unusually broad surface area (models, workflows, features, and platform). This role is central to that effort. This role reports to our Head of Product and IP Legal and will work closely day-to-day with our Lead AI Product Counsel.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

Monitor and translate emerging AI regulations into practical product guidance, launch requirements, and risk-based recommendations for cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the last year we’ve made a lot of progress producing quality content and messaging, and we’re now looking for someone to help us distribute it to the right audiences.

As Demand Generation Lead, you’ll own how future customers find and first experience Linear, across web, search, and paid media. Your objective is to build awareness and pipeline, particularly with larger companies.

It’s likely this role will operate and feel a little different to what you might find elsewhere. Linear is a very brand forward company, so there will be scenarios where we have to turn down seemingly great opportunities to protect perception. We’re unlikely to ever use retargeting pixels and gated content, for example.

We’ve got a basic demand motion in place today but we’ve barely scratched the surface. As the first demand generation hire, you’ll own the strategy and lead on delivering it.

The marketing team is small but has an outsized impact, and we intend to keep it that way. You’ll have real influence on how Linear grows, and you’ll be encouraged to take ownership and deploy tooling and practices that help you be more effective.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work with Magic, our in-house design team, on the web pages and ad creative that future customers see first

 - Own paid media end to end, from channel strategy and budget to the creative itself, including account-based campaigns for enterprise accounts in partnership with sales and event marketing

 - Own search, both the classic kind and the answers AI gives when someone asks which tools to use

 - Define how we measure success for this motion

 - Use AI and automation tools actively to move faster and do more. This is a core part of how we expect this role to operate, not a nice-to-have

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years in growth or demand generation at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on experience across web, paid media, and ABM, and real time spent generating pipeline for an enterprise sales team

 - Genuine design sense. You can direct creative and identify when something feels off

 - Strong instincts around Linear’s core audience (product and engineering teams), and you can speak their language

 - Disciplined with capital (anyone can throw dollars at problems), but you know when to double down

 - Fluent in measurement without being captive to it. You can build the reporting and argue the pipeline math, and still defend spend a dashboard will never really explain

 - Deep fluency with AI tooling. You default to automation and use it to do work that would otherwise take a team

 - Very well versed with attribution, but somewhat disillusioned with it. We’re not going to spend much energy defining attribution, we just need someone with good instincts

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Make an Org Chart You Want to Ship — Advice from Linear on How Heirloom Tomatoes Should Inspire Team Design https://review.firstround.com/make-an-org-chart-you-want-to-ship-advice-from-linear-on-how-heirloom-tomatoes-should-inspire-team-design/

jobs.title: Har du erfaring med autisme, angst og PTSD – og motiveres du af at skabe udvikling gennem en stabil, tillidsfuld og fagligt funderet relation?
jobs.description:
Vi søger medarbejdere til en længerevarende § 85-indsats omkring en ung mand i Aarhus. 
Målet er at etablere et lille, fast team, som kan skabe kontinuitet, genkendelighed og tryghed omkring borgeren.

Om indsatsen

Borgeren har autisme, angst og svær PTSD og har behov for struktureret og forudsigelig støtte i hverdagen.

Han kan opleve svære angstanfald, som i perioder påvirker hans evne til at handle og gennemføre almindelige hverdagsaktiviteter. En central del af opgaven er derfor at kunne bevare roen, skabe tryghed og støtte ham i at udvikle og anvende mestringsstrategier, når angsten fylder.

Samtidig er han selv motiveret for udvikling og progression. Der er derfor gode muligheder for at arbejde målrettet med små, men betydningsfulde skridt mod større mestring og selvstændighed.

Hvad skal du arbejde med?

Den socialpædagogiske støtte har blandt andet fokus på:

  • mestringsstrategier i forbindelse med angst og angstanfald
  • støtte til at finde ro og genvinde handlekraft i belastende situationer
  • struktur og opretholdelse af en stabil døgnrytme
  • støtte til hensigtsmæssige rutiner omkring søvn
  • social færdighedstræning
  • gradvis træning i at færdes uden for hjemmet, eksempelvis gennem gåture
  • støtte til aktiviteter uden for hjemmet og øget selvstændighed i hverdagen.

Opgaven kræver, at du kan arbejde roligt, tålmodigt og relationsorienteret. Du skal kunne møde borgeren dér, hvor han er, uden at forcere processen – samtidig med at du har blik for hans ressourcer, motivation og muligheder for progression.

 

Du bliver en del af et fast team

Kontinuitet er en vigtig del af indsatsen. Derfor søger vi medarbejdere, som ønsker at blive en del af et lille og fast team omkring borgeren.

Teamet skal så vidt muligt være selvdækkende og sammen skabe den stabilitet og genkendelighed, som borgeren har behov for.

I teamet deler I faglige perspektiver, metoder, observationer og erfaringer, så der skabes en fælles og sammenhængende tilgang til indsatsen. Der afholdes desuden løbende teammøder med mulighed for faglig sparring og koordinering.

 

Arbejdstider

Indsatsen leveres på faste tidspunkter:

Mandag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Tirsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Onsdag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Torsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Fredag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Søndag: kl. 21.00-23.00

 

Fra 1. september øges dagvagterne til fire timer og placeres kl. 8.00-12.00 eller kl. 9.00-13.00.

Vagttidspunkterne ligger fast og kan ikke flyttes.

Du behøver ikke kunne dække alle vagterne. Vi hører også gerne fra dig, hvis du kan varetage én eller flere faste vagter og dermed indgå stabilt i teamet.

 

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, som har de faglige og personlige kompetencer til at arbejde med en borger med autisme, angst og svær PTSD.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring med et eller flere af områderne og eksempelvis har en social-, pædagogisk- eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • kan skabe ro, tryghed og forudsigelighed
  • kan bevare ro og overblik, når angsten fylder
  • arbejder respektfuldt og relationsorienteret
  • forstår betydningen af struktur og kontinuitet
  • kan arbejde udviklingsorienteret med respekt for borgerens tempo
  • er stabil og kan forpligte dig på faste vagter
  • bidrager aktivt til faglig sparring og et tæt teamsamarbejde.

Af hensyn til borgerens konkrete behov kan indsatsen udelukkende varetages af kvindelige medarbejdere.

Der er aktuelt ingen fastsat slutdato på indsatsen, og vi søger derfor medarbejdere, som har mulighed for at skabe kontinuitet over tid.

 

Kan du se dig selv i opgaven?

Hvis du har erfaring med autisme, angst og/eller PTSD og trives i et tæt relationsarbejde, hvor udvikling sker gennem tryghed, struktur og vedholdenhed, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Ved interesse får du naturligvis yderligere information om borgeren, støttebehovet og de faglige rammer som en del af den videre rekrutteringsproces.

 

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Teammøder, supervision og konflikthåndteringskurser
  • Faglig udvikling og sparring med kolleger
  • Attraktiv løn iflg. overenskomst

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV samt dine uddannelsesbeviser ved at klikke "Søg Stillingen" længere nede på siden.

Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role

-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design

Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success

 - International Growth: Analyze global expansion opportunities including localization, regional pricing strategies, go-to-market approaches, and commercial partnerships

Corporate Development & Investor Relations

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

jobs.title: ASISTENT/ICA U PRODAJI I PRETPRODAJI
jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • istraživati tržište i pronalaziti građevinske tvrtke koje odgovaraju našoj ciljanoj skupini
  • sastavljati i redovito ažurirati popise potencijalnih korisnika
  • pronalaziti vlasnike, direktore i druge osobe odgovorne za donošenje odluka
  • istraživati osnovne podatke o tvrtki prije prvog kontakta
  • kontaktirati potencijalne korisnike putem e-maila i telefona
  • predstaviti razlog javljanja i provjeriti postoji li interes za razgovor
  • voditi komunikaciju od prvog kontakta do dogovaranja prodajne prezentacije
  • zakazivati termine i pripremati prodaji informacije o potencijalnom korisniku
  • voditi urednu evidenciju svih kontakata i aktivnosti u HubSpotu
  • pratiti dogovorene rokove i planirati ponovne kontakte
  • pripremati i slati ponude, ugovore i fakture prema postojećim predlošcima
  • surađivati s prodajom i osobom zaduženom za odnose s korisnicima
  • na početku ćete upoznati Insidico, postojeće korisnike i probleme koje aplikacija rješava
  • proći ćete naš način pronalaska potencijalnih korisnika, primjere dosadašnjih e-mailova i poziva, pravila rada u hubspotu te način na koji se dogovorena prezentacija predaje prodaji
  • prve popise kontakata, e-mailove i pozive prolazit ćemo zajedno. Cilj je da nakon razdoblja uhodavanja možete samostalno organizirati svoj rad i voditi pretprodajne aktivnosti
  • opseg aktivnosti i očekivani rezultati prilagođavat će se dogovorenom broju radnih sati
Poslodavac traži:
  • tražimo osobu koja zna jasno komunicirati, dobro organizirati svoj rad i samostalno doći do potrebnih informacija
  • važno nam je da nemate problem nazvati osobu s kojom prethodno niste razgovarali.U ovom poslu bit će neodgovorenih e-mailova, odbijenih poziva i odgovora da tvrtka trenutačno nije zainteresirana. Očekujemo da takve situacije prihvatite kao normalan dio prodajnog procesa i nastavite raditi bez nepotrebnog pritiska na potencijalnog korisnika.
  • prethodno iskustvo u prodaji nije uvjet. Spremni smo raditi i s osobom koja tek ulazi u prodaju, ali očekujemo interes za učenje, samostalnost i odgovornost prema dogovorenim zadacima.
Uvjeti:
  • najmanje završena srednja škola
  • razvijene usmene i pisane komunikacijske vještine
  • organiziranost i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • samostalnost, upornost i snalažljivost
  • urednost u vođenju podataka i praćenju rokova
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • korištenje programa Microsoft Office i Outlook
  • spremnost na rad u HubSpotu, Google kalendaru, Google Meetu i internim alatima
  • aktivno znanje hrvatskog jezika
  • B2B prodaji ili telefonskom kontaktiranju potencijalnih korisnika
  • istraživanju tržišta i izradi baza kontakata
  • radu u CRM sustavu, posebno HubSpotu
  • građevinskoj industriji
  • prodaji softvera ili drugih poslovnih usluga
Poslodavac nudi:
  • rad na nepuno radno vrijeme uz mogućnost kasnijeg prelaska na puno radno vrijeme
  • mogućnost rada putem ugovora o radu ili studentskog ugovora
  • fleksibilan raspored unutar unaprijed dogovorenog broja sati
  • rad iz našeg ureda u Osijeku
  • mogućnost djelomičnog rada od kuće nakon razdoblja uhodavanja
  • dogovoreni sustav nagrađivanja prema rezultatima
  • rad u malom timu u kojem ćete izravno surađivati s prodajom i Customer Successom
  • detaljan onboarding i podršku tijekom prvih mjeseci
  • mogućnost napredovanja prema samostalnom vođenju prodajnih prezentacija i prodajnih procesa
Postupak odabira: Kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor bit će pozvani na razgovor i praktično testiranje. Testiranje će uključivati zadatke povezane s istraživanjem potencijalnih korisnika, pisanom komunikacijom, organizacijom rada i kratkom simulacijom telefonskog razgovora. Ne očekujemo da prije razgovora poznajete sve funkcionalnosti Insidica. Zanima nas kako razmišljate, pronalazite informacije, komunicirate i organizirate zadatke. Prijava Pošaljite životopis na matej@insidico.com najkasnije do 01. rujna 2026. Planirani početak rada je tijekom rujna 2026., prema dogovoru s odabranim kandidatom.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



TEAM

Brand & Creative defines how Replit shows up in the world and leads the creative work that brings it to market. On the Brand side, the function sets company-level direction: defining the brand, shaping the narrative, and establishing how Replit is understood and expressed in the market. On the Creative side, the function leads the planning, development, and execution of creative work across campaigns, launches, events, and major company initiatives; translating strategy into high-quality outputs across every touchpoint. Brand & Creative ensures that what Replit is and what Replit makes remain aligned. Resulting in a clear, consistent, and differentiated brand experience across the company.




ROLE

The Brand Designer is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining the Replit brand system. The role focuses on core brand foundations and their application across key surfaces, including product and marketing. In partnership with internal and external partners, this role ensures the brand is clear, consistent, and scalable across all touchpoints. This role reports to the Brand & Creative Lead.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and evolve the Replit visual brand system

 - Design and maintain core brand assets, guidelines, and documentation

 - Apply the brand system across key surfaces including product, web, and primary marketing channels

 - Partner with Product and Design to ensure consistent brand expression within the product experience

 - Provide guidance and feedback to internal teams and external partners on brand usage

 - Partner with external design studios and agencies to develop and extend the brand system

 - Review and direct external work to ensure alignment with brand standards

 - Ensure consistency and quality across all brand-critical touchpoints

 - Develop scalable design frameworks that support long-term brand growth

 - Contribute hands-on design work on high-visibility and foundational projects




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5-7+ years of experience in brand design, visual systems, or identity design

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating brand systems, identity work, and application across multiple touchpoints

 - Expertise in typography, layout, and visual systems

 - Experience building and maintaining design systems at scale

 - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

 - Ability to balance conceptual thinking with executional rigor

 - Experience working with external agencies or design partners

 - Strong attention to detail and consistency

 - Experience collaborating with Product and cross-functional teams



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
jobs.description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.
Contact:  For more information, please contact us at CAEHF@proton.me

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, MEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Arabic.




NICE TO HAVES:

 -  Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Work in lockstep with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and Enablement to evolve messaging, plays, and processes to ensure consistent execution across the region.

 - Talent Development & Performance Management: Hire, onboard, and ramp top talent; set clear expectations; deliver timely coaching and feedback; and manage performance to build a durable, promotable bench of Notions’ future SCs.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to draw conclusions, optimise team performance, and drive continuous improvement.

 - People-Centric Leader: A natural mentor with a proven track record of coaching, developing, and uplifting sales professionals in a supportive and inclusive manner.

 - Proven Track Record: Extensive experience in SaaS sales including outbound prospecting, closing new business and demonstrating an ability to consistently achieve goals in a highly competitive environment.

jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Everybody in the company is rewarded with a share of profit each December—we succeed together.

Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

  • Learn to be a product expert and confidently answer product questions from prospects

  • Support the complete sales cycle, from qualified lead to close

  • Must live in Europe
  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)
  • Loads of energy, humour, passion, and empathy
  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people

  • You have access to fast, reliable internet and a dedicated space to work without distractions

Work-life balance

Personal development and wellbeing

  • Commitment to continued learning and development

Location and compensation

  • Full-time role, based remotely, work anywhere within Europe
  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location
  • Budget for computer and office equipment (pending 6 month probationary period)

 

Respect, growth and stability

  • Friendly, sociable, responsible, collaborative team (a great place to be)

  • Regular communication with global team via chat and video calls
  • Dynamic, young, growing tech company leveraging all the latest tech tools and leading industry trends

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

jobs.title: Solutions Consultants Manager, Enterprise - Japan (Sales Leadership)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

jobs.title: Notino Experience Program Manager - EMEA & APAC, Early Career
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This early-career Notino Experience Program Manager role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and turns it into momentum. You’ll wear many hats across the People team, but your core job is to jump in, chart the path, and drive high-impact projects based on business priorities—bringing clarity, aligning cross-functional partners, and executing quickly so the team can deliver meaningful employee experiences across EMEA and APAC.

You’ll succeed here if you’re deeply curious, eager to grow, and excited to hone your craft in People. This is a launchpad opportunity to learn from strong leaders, build expertise across the full spectrum of People work, and help shape moments that matter—bringing energy, optimism, and genuine care for people while helping build a workplace where everyone can do the best work of their careers.

As the regional anchor for how Notion’s global people & environment programs come to life outside the U.S., you’ll sit at the intersection of global vision and local execution. Based in Dublin and reporting to the Notino Experience & Environment Lead for APAC & EMEA, you’ll partner closely with the Global Experience Programs team in AMER and environment teams across Dublin, Sydney, Tokyo, Seoul, and Hyderabad—translating global programs into locally relevant, high-quality experiences and building the operational infrastructure to deliver them consistently at scale.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own regional program operations. Take end-to-end ownership of key people programs across EMEA and APAC — from onboarding and performance cycles to engagement surveys and talent retention initiatives. You'll research, plan, launch, and iterate.

 - Bridge global and local. Act as the connective layer between the Global Experience Programs team and on-the-ground environment teams. You'll translate global frameworks into locally relevant experiences.

 - Build the infrastructure. Create processes, playbooks, and agents that make local execution easier and more consistent across markets. Think onboarding workflows, program calendars, and repeatable delivery frameworks.

 - Elevate Affinity Groups. Partner with Affinity Group leads across the region to strengthen their programmes, provide operational support, and help surface retention and engagement insights from within those communities.

 - Use data to drive decisions. Build and maintain dashboards that track program health, adoption, and outcomes. Use what you learn to run experiments, course-correct quickly, and demonstrate ROI.

 - Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with People Partners, NoE , Recruitment and business leaders to align people programs with organisational goals and ensure an inclusive, well-supported employee experience.

 - Champion the Notion Experience. Help craft and bring to life a more distinct Notino Experience brand across EMEA and APAC — reimagining how we work, how we connect, and what it feels like to be a Notino in your region.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Programatic: experience running people programs end-to-end, across multiple markets & time zones.

 - AI-native mindset: you’re “AI‑pilled” in the best way: you proactively use AI tools to speed up research, ops, and communication, and you’re excited to build AI agents/playbooks.

 - Project management: strong skills and the ability to hold many moving pieces.

 - Stakeholder trust: you build trust naturally across levels, from team members to executive partners.

 - Bias toward action: you’re resourceful, scrappy when needed, and energised by a fast-moving environment.

 - Change management: experience driving change at a high-growth company — you know how to bring people along, not just roll things out.

 - Executive presence: you’re comfortable presenting to and partnering with senior leaders.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with or enthusiasm for Notion

 - Experience working across APAC and EMEA markets, with an understanding of cultural nuance in employee experience.
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €60,000 - €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.description:

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline

Your profile

- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.title: Mobile Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the experience of our iOS and Android mobile apps, including guiding the adaptation of desktop features to mobile

 - Pair closely with mobile engineers and product leads to initiate and complete mobile-specific projects, no hand-offs

 - Take opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

 - Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

 - Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress across both mobile and desktop platforms

 - Use and improve our lightweight design system components

 - Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years experience designing software, with mobile-specific emphasis

 - Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

 - Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

 - Experience with prototyping directly in code, or with tools like Figma, Origami, etc

 - Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute
